paper.title: Tevatron-Elastic: A Unified Abstraction for Training Elastic Retrievers and Rerankers
paper.abstract: A single model scale challenges the flexibility of a production retrieval system: some settings need it faster, others need a smaller index, and the right trade-off changes with the workload. In the context of information retrieval (IR), a transformer-based model can be made smaller in three ways---using fewer layers, passing fewer tokens through the upper layers, or producing a shorter embedding---and each way saves a different compute resource. These options have been studied one at a time, ea

summary.core_problem: 生产检索系统需要在速度、索引大小和精度之间动态取舍，但现有 retriever/reranker 通常只能按单一模型尺寸部署。
summary.importance: 贡献是检索模型的弹性训练抽象和工程统一，覆盖层数、token 经过上层的数量、embedding 维度三种压缩轴；它对 LLM serving 和 RAG 系统有参考价值，但不是基座预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: Tevatron-Elastic 用一个统一的 size object 表示模型可运行的任意配置，并用短 schedule 指定训练时采样的配置集合。训练后得到一个 checkpoint，部署时可选择不同层深、token 路由深度或向量维度；同一抽象覆盖 retriever 与 reranker，也覆盖 encoder 与 decoder 模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集、baseline 数值或提升幅度。实验重点应是比较单轴弹性方法与统一多轴弹性训练在检索质量、延迟、索引大小和算力占用上的折中。
summary.authors_note: Jimmy Lin 是信息检索和 Tevatron 系列工作的代表作者；Vivek Srikumar 长期从事 NLP 与结构化学习研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Production retrieval systems need runtime trade-offs among latency, index size, and accuracy, while most retrievers and rerankers are trained and deployed at a single fixed scale.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a unified abstraction for elastic training of retrieval models, spanning layer depth, token depth through upper layers, and embedding dimensionality. It is relevant to LLM serving and RAG infrastructure, but it is not a foundation-model pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tevatron-Elastic represents any executable model size with a single size object and uses a compact schedule to specify which sizes are trained. One checkpoint can then serve multiple configurations at deployment, varying depth, token processing, or embedding dimension. The abstraction is designed to cover both retrievers and rerankers, and both encoder and decoder models.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report concrete model sizes, datasets, baseline numbers, or gains. The expected experimental focus is the quality-latency-index-size trade-off compared with separately trained single-axis elastic approaches.
summary_en.authors_note: Jimmy Lin is a well-known information retrieval researcher and a key figure behind the Tevatron line of work; Vivek Srikumar is known for NLP and structured prediction research.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法抽象和资源分解即可；它不会改变预训练 recipe，但对 RAG 检索侧的弹性 serving 有实用参考。
recommendation.en: Read only the abstraction and resource decomposition; it will not change a pretraining recipe, but it is useful for elastic retrieval-side serving in RAG systems.

paper.title: Does More Retrieved Evidence Help Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Diffusion Language Models?
paper.abstract: Visual retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) commonly expands the retrieved evidence set to improve answer-page coverage, implicitly assuming that all available evidence should be passed to the generator. We show that this assumption does not hold for diffusion language models (DLMs): retrieving more pages increases answer-page recall, whereas unconditionally passing all retrieved pages to the generator often reduces answer accuracy, primarily because of semantic conflict. A latent-source analysi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个很具体、但对新型语言建模范式很关键的问题：在视觉 RAG 里，给 diffusion language model 提供更多检索证据，为什么会出现“检索覆盖更高，但最终答案更差”的反常现象。传统 AR-RAG 的直觉是 top-k 越大，答案页被召回的概率越高，生成器就更容易答对；但在多模态 DLM 中，多个页面会同时进入并行去噪过程，所有未决 token 位置共享这些视觉条件。这样一来，若不同页面分别支持不同但各自自洽的答案，模型在位置级并行提议时会把不兼容的信息拼接起来，生成一个没有任何单一页面支持的混合答案。论文把这个问题刻画为 source-coherence loss，即并行去噪破坏了“答案应来自同一潜在证据源”的耦合约束。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在于提出了一个通用 DLM 训练目标，而在于它把 diffusion/并行生成范式在 RAG 场景下的一个结构性弱点讲清楚了。AR 模型逐 token 条件化，天然更容易沿着单一证据链展开；DLM 的并行去噪则可能在早期就把多个来源混合。这个观察对后续几类工作都有启发：一是多模态 DLM 的上下文构造不能直接照搬 AR-RAG 的“多给证据总没错”；二是 generator-side evidence admission 需要和 DLM 的去噪几何匹配，而不是只看 retriever 分数；三是第一步去噪分布本身可以作为诊断和控制信号。这类分析对 diffusion LM、any-order LM、masked LM 一类非 AR 生成器如何接入外部知识，属于有方法论价值的补充。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上分两部分。第一部分是机制分析。作者先在固定 top-k 输入设置下，对 3 个多模态 DLM 和 5 个视觉 QA benchmark 做系统比较，发现 Recall@k 随 k 上升，但宏平均答案准确率反而下降。随后他们把额外页面分成不同条件，指出真正造成退化的是 semantic conflict，而不是“多图输入”本身。理论上，论文在 first unresolved denoising state 上做了一个受限 latent-source 分析：若正确页和冲突页分别支持不同完整答案，而答案跨多个 token 位置，那么理想模型应在这些位置上共享同一个 latent source 选择；但位置独立的 proposal 会丢掉这种耦合，于是给 cross-source answer 分配非零概率，而且冲突跨度越长，unsupported mass 越大。第二部分是训练外的证据筛选框架 ECF。它包含 multi-granularity evidence construction 和 generator-side admission 两步。前者把整页和版面区域一起建索引，解决答案局部化问题；后者不直接依据检索分数选页，而是对每个候选页 ci，在 {c1, ci} 与 {c1, blank(ci)} 两种条件下比较目标 DLM 第一去噪步 answer block 的熵，得到 conditional confidence gain。这个设计的关键在于用 blank 对照消掉“多一个视觉输入槽位”带来的结构性影响，只测候选内容本身是否降低竞争源风险。最后再结合 rank prior 决定是否从 top-1 扩展到更多证据，以及扩展到哪一页。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个多模态 DLM、5 个视觉 QA 数据集，并在统一的 VisRAG 排序候选池、prompt、解码预算和答案评分器下比较 fixed top-k 与选择式证据接入。核心结果有三层。第一，现象层：top-k 从 1 增到 2、3 时，answer-page recall 持续上升，但在 15 个 model-dataset 组合上的宏平均答案准确率下降。第二，机制层：在作者构造或归类的页面条件中，conflicting pages 导致的精度下降最大；而且这种干扰在第一步 answer-block 分布里就能看到——在自然检索到的 ChartQA 样本上，冲突页条件下 first-step answer-block accuracy 降幅最大，与 correct-only 分布的 Jensen-Shannon divergence 也最大，并且这与最终答案退化方向一致。第三，方法层：ECF 在 5 个 benchmark、3 个 DLM 上，相比最强 fixed top-k 输入平均提升 2.62 个百分点；在 LLaDA2.0-Uni 上，相比最强 training-free baseline 平均再高 2.37 个百分点。论文还强调，ECF 的收益在 candidate pool 扩大时更稳定，说明它确实把“候选池大小”和“最终上下文大小”解耦了，而不是只在某个固定 k 上碰巧有效。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合带着“DLM 为什么和 AR 在 RAG 上行为不同”这个问题去读。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1、Figure 2，把 availability–accuracy mismatch 以及 first-step signal 的经验事实抓住。然后重点读 3.3 的 latent-source analysis 和对应命题，那里是全文最有信息量的部分：作者不是泛泛地说“多证据会冲突”，而是把冲突如何在并行去噪里变成 unsupported mixed answer 讲清楚了。接着看 ECF 的定义，尤其是 {c1, ci} 对 {c1, blank(ci)} 的 counterfactual 设计，理解为什么要做 geometry-matched 对照，而不是直接比较加入候选前后的熵。实验部分建议重点看三类表图：top-k 扫描、冲突类型分解、first-step 与 final-answer 的对应关系。若时间有限，读完机制分析和主结果就够；若想深挖，可以继续看 multi-granularity evidence construction 的实现细节，判断它的收益有多少来自更好的检索覆盖，有多少来自 generator-side filtering。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific but important failure mode of diffusion language models in visual RAG: retrieving more evidence improves answer-page recall, yet passing all retrieved pages to the generator often hurts final answer accuracy. The usual AR-RAG intuition is that larger top-k should help because the answer-bearing page is more likely to be included. The authors show that this intuition breaks for multimodal DLMs. During parallel denoising, multiple visual pages jointly condition all unresolved answer positions. If different pages support different coherent answers, position-wise proposals can mix incompatible sources and assign probability to hybrid answers that are supported by neither page. The paper frames this as source-coherence loss: the denoising process fails to preserve the coupling that all answer tokens should come from the same latent evidence source.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining-oriented readers is not a new training objective, but a clear account of a structural weakness of non-AR generation under retrieval augmentation. AR models expand answers token by token and are less exposed to this kind of cross-source mixing. DLMs, because they denoise many positions jointly, can fail much earlier in the generation process. That matters for diffusion LM, masked LM, and any-order LM research more broadly: evidence selection cannot simply inherit AR-era heuristics such as “more retrieved context is safer.” The paper also suggests that generator-native signals from early denoising steps can be used for context control, which is a useful design direction for retrieval interfaces to non-autoregressive generators.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work has two main parts. First, it establishes and explains the mismatch. Under fixed top-k input settings, the authors evaluate three multimodal DLMs on five visual QA benchmarks using the same VisRAG-ranked candidate pools, prompts, decoding budgets, and answer scorer. They show that Recall@k increases with k, while macro-average answer accuracy drops. They then isolate the cause and find that semantic conflict, not merely the presence of multiple images, is the main driver of degradation. The theoretical analysis focuses on the first unresolved denoising state. When a correct page and a conflicting page each support a different coherent answer, the correct latent structure requires multiple answer positions to share one source choice. A position-factorized proposal breaks this dependence and allocates probability mass to cross-source answers; the unsupported mass grows as the conflict spans more answer positions. Second, the paper proposes ECF, a training-free evidence admission framework. It combines multi-granularity evidence construction, where both full pages and layout-derived regions are indexed, with generator-side candidate filtering. For each additional candidate ci, ECF compares the target DLM’s first-step answer-block entropy under {c1, ci} versus {c1, blank(ci)}. This yields a conditional confidence gain that controls for the structural effect of adding another visual slot and measures whether the candidate content itself reduces competing-source risk. A rank-prior selection rule then decides whether to expand beyond the top-1 page and which candidate to admit.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans three multimodal DLMs and five visual QA benchmarks. The main empirical findings come in three layers. First, the phenomenon itself: increasing top-k from 1 to 2 or 3 consistently raises answer-page recall, but lowers macro-average answer accuracy across 15 model-dataset combinations. Second, the mechanism: conflicting pages produce the largest accuracy drop among the tested evidence conditions. The same interference is already visible in the first-step answer-block distribution. On naturally retrieved ChartQA cases, the conflicting-page condition causes the largest drop in first-step answer-block accuracy and the largest Jensen-Shannon divergence from the correct-only distribution, and this aligns with the largest final-answer degradation. Third, the method result: across five benchmarks and three DLMs, ECF improves over the strongest fixed top-k input by 2.62 percentage points on average. With LLaDA2.0-Uni, it also beats the strongest training-free baseline by 2.37 points on average. The paper further reports that ECF remains more stable as the candidate pool grows, which supports the claim that it decouples candidate-pool size from final context size rather than merely tuning a better fixed k.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it with one question in mind: why does retrieval behave differently for DLMs than for AR generators? Start with the introduction and the main figures showing the availability-accuracy mismatch and the first-step signal. Then spend most of the time on the latent-source analysis in Section 3.3 and the associated propositions. That is where the paper becomes more than an empirical warning; it gives a concrete mechanism for how parallel denoising creates unsupported mixed answers. After that, look closely at the ECF design, especially the counterfactual comparison between {c1, ci} and {c1, blank(ci)}. The blanked control is important because it isolates candidate content from the mere geometry of adding another visual input. In the experiments, focus on three pieces: the top-k sweep, the conflict-type breakdown, and the correspondence between first-step distributions and final answers. If reading time is limited, the mechanism section plus the main result tables are enough to capture the contribution.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看机制，不是看 RAG trick：它说明 DLM 的并行去噪会放大多源冲突，先读 latent-source analysis 和 first-step 分布那部分。
recommendation.en: Read it for the mechanism, not the RAG trick: it shows parallel denoising in DLMs amplifies multi-source conflict; start with the latent-source analysis and first-step distribution evidence.

paper.title: TEPA: Revoking Stale Memories for Conflict-Robust Language Agents
paper.abstract: Long-term memory enables language agents to reuse past facts, preferences, and task experience. Persistence also creates a central falsifiability problem: when the world changes, stale memories can remain retrievable and pollute the prompt. We characterize this failure mode as memory pollution: degradation caused by active memories that newer conflicting evidence has superseded. We introduce TEPA, a revocable evidence-memory mechanism that makes validity an explicit state of memory. TEPA represe

summary.core_problem: 语言智能体的长期记忆存在「记忆污染」失效模式：当外部环境、用户偏好或工具状态发生变化时，已被新证据推翻的旧记忆仍可被检索到，作为提示词证据干扰当前决策，在冲突场景下带记忆系统的表现甚至不如无记忆基线。
summary.importance: 记忆有效性的显式状态建模思路可迁移到预训练研究：一是为持续预训练中的知识更新提供新的设计方向，替代单纯依赖灾难性遗忘或全量重训的方案；二是为预训练语料中冲突事实的处理、知识库对齐提供参考；三是为长上下文模型的证据有效性判断目标设计提供启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出TEPA可撤销证据记忆机制，核心是给记忆设置显式生命周期状态。具体设计：1. 将每条观测映射为带键的先例（keyed precedent），键标识记忆主题（如用户偏好槽、工具状态槽），值为对应声明；2. 记忆存储分为活跃集和撤销集，常规检索只返回活跃集中的内容；3. 当新证据与活跃集中的先例同键且值冲突时，自动将旧先例转移到撤销集，保留审计路径但不参与常规检索。另有TEPA-Full变体，在有可执行验证条件时，会先验证候选先例再将其提升为活跃状态。同时定义分阶段记忆污染指数（MPI），量化某一阶段带记忆方法相对无记忆基线的性能退化程度。
summary.experiments: 在四类冲突场景下评测：受控隐藏状态漂移、真实文件支持的可执行漂移、用户偏好更新、MemoryAgentBench SH-6k事实整合基准。结果显示，仅追加式记忆和键值缓存基线在反转阶段出现明显性能下降，部分场景下差于无记忆基线；TEPA的可撤销生命周期记忆在所有场景下均保持鲁棒。多跳推理和超长上下文变体的实验显示，检索链构建是下一阶段的主要瓶颈。
summary.reading_guide: 先读第2节问题形式化部分，理解记忆污染的定义和分阶段记忆污染指数的计算逻辑；再读第3节方法部分，重点看记忆状态机和冲突撤销机制；实验部分重点关注反转阶段的性能对比和污染指数指标。预计阅读时间20分钟左右。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-term memory in language agents suffers from a "memory pollution" failure mode: when external environments, user preferences, or tool states change, stale memories superseded by new conflicting evidence remain retrievable and contaminate prompt context, leading to performance worse than no-memory baselines in conflict scenarios.
summary_en.importance: The explicit validity state modeling for memories transfers to pretraining research: it offers a new design direction for knowledge update in continual pretraining as an alternative to catastrophic forgetting or full retraining, informs strategies for handling conflicting facts in pretraining corpora and knowledge base alignment, and inspires objective design for evidence validity judgment in long-context models.
summary_en.technical_approach: TEPA is a revocable evidence memory mechanism that assigns explicit lifecycle states to stored memories. Each observation is mapped to a keyed precedent, where the key identifies the memory topic (e.g., user preference slot, tool regime slot) and the value is the corresponding claim. Memories are split into an active set (used for ordinary retrieval) and a revoked set (retained for audit but excluded from regular retrieval). When new evidence conflicts with an active precedent under the same key, the stale precedent is automatically moved to the revoked set. A TEPA-Full variant adds pre-promotion validation for candidate precedents when executable verification is available. A phase-wise Memory Pollution Index (MPI) is defined to quantify how much worse a memory-equipped method performs relative to a no-memory baseline in a given phase.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across four conflict settings: controlled hidden regime drift, real file-backed executable drift, user preference updates, and the MemoryAgentBench SH-6k fact consolidation benchmark. Append-only memory and key-cache baselines degrade significantly during reversal phases, performing worse than no-memory baselines in some cases; TEPA's revocable lifecycle memory remains robust across all settings. Experiments on multi-hop and very long-context variants identify retrieval chain construction as the next major bottleneck.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with Section 2 (problem formulation) to understand the memory pollution definition and phase-wise Memory Pollution Index calculation. Then read Section 3 for TEPA's memory state machine and conflict revocation mechanism. For experiments, focus on reversal-phase performance comparisons and MPI metrics. Estimated reading time: ~20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 记忆污染是agent长期运行的真实痛点，TEPA的keyed-revocation思路干净；对预训练研究员价值在理解记忆失效模式，看§2的问题定义即可
recommendation.en: Memory pollution is a real pain point for long-running agents; TEPA's keyed-revocation is clean. For pretraining researchers, the value is the failure-mode characterization in §2.

paper.title: Universal Pathologies, Conditional Consequences: A Triple-Robustness Analysis of RAG for Multi-Hop Traceability
paper.abstract: GraphRAG underperforms vector RAG on citation precision in many reports, but where and why have remained corpus-bound. We present a triple-robustness analysis that holds the retrieval architecture fixed and varies three orthogonal axes embedder (local e5-small -> Azure text-embedding-3-small), corpus (DO-178C typed-edge requirements -> Wikipedia paragraph chains via MuSiQue), and judge (paired GPT-5.4 x GPT-4.1) across 4,440 main-matrix runs, 600 cross-corpus runs, and 1,200 paired faithfulness

summary.core_problem: 分析 GraphRAG 在多跳可追溯问答中为什么会出现过度引用、低 citation precision，以及这种问题何时会伤害 faithfulness。
summary.importance: 贡献是 RAG 系统行为分析，不是通用预训练方法；价值在于把 GraphRAG 的失效模式拆成架构、语料和 judge 三个维度，对做工具增强和检索增强模型的人有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 固定检索架构，同时改变三条轴线：embedder 从本地 e5-small 到 Azure text-embedding-3-small，corpus 从 DO-178C typed-edge requirements 到 MuSiQue/Wikipedia paragraph chains，judge 使用 paired GPT-5.4 与 GPT-4.1；通过主矩阵、跨语料和成对 faithfulness 判断分析稳健性。
summary.experiments: 报告 4,440 次 main-matrix runs、600 次 cross-corpus runs 和 1,200 次 paired faithfulness judgments。GraphRAG 在三个设置中均输出 11-15 个 citation IDs，citation precision 为 0.12-0.23，retrieval recall 为 0.68-0.87；在 DO-178C typed-edge 语料上 faithfulness 随 hop 从 74% 降到 40%，而在 Wikipedia chains 上从 42% 升到 58%。
summary.authors_note: Technische Hochschule Ingolstadt 与 Independent Researcher；未见可确认的知名作者背景信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why GraphRAG over-cites and suffers low citation precision in multi-hop traceability, and when that behavior harms faithfulness.
summary_en.importance: This is a RAG behavior analysis rather than a pretraining contribution. Its useful part is the decomposition of GraphRAG failure modes across architecture, corpus type, and judge choice.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study keeps the retrieval architecture fixed while varying three axes: embedder choice, corpus type, and judge model. It compares local e5-small and Azure text-embedding-3-small, DO-178C typed-edge requirements and MuSiQue/Wikipedia paragraph chains, and paired GPT-5.4/GPT-4.1 judgments.
summary_en.experiments: It reports 4,440 main-matrix runs, 600 cross-corpus runs, and 1,200 paired faithfulness judgments. GraphRAG emits 11-15 citation IDs with citation precision of 0.12-0.23 and retrieval recall of 0.68-0.87. Faithfulness drops from 74% to 40% across hops on typed-edge DO-178C, but rises from 42% to 58% on Wikipedia chains.
summary_en.authors_note: Technische Hochschule Ingolstadt and an independent researcher; no clearly identifiable widely known authors from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: RAG 不是预训练主线，但 GraphRAG 过引证的数字值得记；读 abstract 的 C2a/C2b 就够。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining thread, but the GraphRAG over-citation numbers are worth remembering; the C2a/C2b claims in the abstract are enough.

paper.title: Beyond Top-K: Replacing Black-Box Retrieval with Interpretable Agentic Operations
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation over long documents is dominated by one design: chunk the text, embed the chunks, and surface the top-k nearest neighbours of the query. We argue that for an important class of documents -- financial statements, audit reports, regulatory returns -- this design is structurally unsound, and we make the argument measurable. On a 780-page government financial report, 86.8% of content lines are table rows, thousands of near-identical figures compete in one embedding spa

summary.core_problem: 传统top-k嵌入检索在含大量表格的长文档（财务/审计/监管报告）中存在结构性缺陷，导致数值与单位/财年信息分离，检索精度严重下降
summary.importance: 通过量化实验证明传统RAG设计在表格密集文档中的系统性失效，提出无嵌入的agentic检索范式，属于原理分析与方法创新
summary.technical_approach: 提出READ（Reliable Embedding-free Agentic Document-search）方法，agent通过三个确定性操作直接读取原始文档结构，完全绕过嵌入检索的chunking错误
summary.experiments: 在780页政府财务报告上测试：86.8%内容为表格行，传统chunking常导致数字与单位（lakh/crore，差两个数量级）分离；表格感知chunker在所有测试chunk尺寸下仍有27-30%数值chunk缺失财年上下文头

summary_en.core_problem: Traditional top-k embedding retrieval has structural flaws in table-heavy long documents (financial/audit/regulatory reports), causing numeric values to be separated from units/fiscal year context and severely degrading retrieval accuracy
summary_en.importance: Quantitatively demonstrates systematic failure of mainstream RAG designs in table-heavy documents, proposes an embedding-free agentic retrieval paradigm, as a principle analysis and methodological innovation
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes READ (Reliable Embedding-free Agentic Document-search), where an agent reads raw document structure through three deterministic operations, completely bypassing chunking errors in embedding-based retrieval
summary_en.experiments: Tested on a 780-page government financial report: 86.8% of content is table rows, traditional chunking often separates numbers from units (lakh/crore, a 100x difference); table-aware chunkers still leave 27-30% of numeric chunks without fiscal year headers at all tested chunk sizes

recommendation.zh: 做长上下文RAG或文档agent的仅看§3的失效分析即可，方法本身仅适配表格密集文档，泛化性未验证
recommendation.en: For long-context RAG or document agent researchers, only read §3 failure analysis; method is limited to table-heavy documents with unproven generalization

paper.title: Search2Skill: Skill Distillation Beyond Knowledge Boundaries Via Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reusable skills, which encapsulate the procedural knowledge required to solve real-world professional tasks, offer LLM-based agents a path toward self-evolution in expert domains. Existing self-evolving skill methods construct skills internally from the model's parametric knowledge or trajectories, and are therefore bounded by what the model already knows. However, the domain conventions and standard procedures underlying professional skills often lie beyond this boundary and are hard to elicit

summary.core_problem: 现有自进化 skill 方法依赖模型自身参数知识或轨迹，无法获取模型知识边界之外的专业领域规范与标准流程。
summary.importance: 方法创新：通过外部搜索填补能力缺口，并用 rubric-based RL 联合优化何时搜、怎么搜、怎么生成 skill。
summary.technical_approach: Search2Skill 自动识别 agent 能力缺口 → 外部搜索证据 → 蒸馏为结构化可复用 skill；用基于 rubric 的强化学习同时优化搜索时机、搜索策略与 skill 生成。
summary.experiments: 在 8 个专家级领域、3 个 benchmark 上验证，相比内部构造 skill 的方法在专业任务上表现更好。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing self-evolving skill methods rely on the model's parametric knowledge or trajectories and cannot acquire domain conventions and standard procedures beyond the model's knowledge boundary.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: fills capability gaps via external search and uses rubric-based RL to jointly optimize when to search, how to search, and how to generate skills.
summary_en.technical_approach: Search2Skill automatically identifies agent capability gaps, searches external sources for evidence, and distills it into structured reusable skills; a rubric-based RL scheme jointly optimizes search timing, search strategy, and skill generation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on eight expert-level domains across three benchmarks, outperforming methods that build skills internally from parametric knowledge.

recommendation.zh: agent 自进化 + 外部检索的常规组合，rubric-based RL 是亮点但非预训练核心，看方法节即可。
recommendation.en: A standard combination of agent self-evolution and external retrieval; rubric-based RL is the main novelty but not core to pretraining—read the method section only.

paper.title: SiMDex: Mining Similar Egocentric Videos for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Manipulation
paper.abstract: Recent years have witnessed an explosive trend of scaling ego-centric human videos for robot manipulation, yet it remains unclear which data actually benefits dexterous manipulation. We present SiMDex, a similarity-based data mining framework that casts human data selection for VLA post-training in dexterous manipulation as a recommendation problem. For each robot demonstration, SiMDex employs a three-layer recall-ranking-re-ranking pipeline to extract task-relevant subsets from a pool of ~32M e

summary.core_problem: 在大规模人类第一视角视频池中，如何为机器人示范/具身 VLA 后训练挑出“真正有用”的少量数据，而不是盲目混合。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是数据筛选/课程：把数据选择显式建模为检索-排序问题，并用强对照（同等数据量随机采样）展示“少而精”优于“多而杂”；对通用 LLM 预训练是类比启发（data curation / retrieval-based mixture），但任务仍偏具身操作。
summary.technical_approach: SiMDex：三层 recall–ranking–re-ranking 管线，从约 3200 万 egocentric 人类视频中为每条机器人 demonstration 挖掘相似样本；在 morphology-agnostic action space 上做匹配，声称无需改 VLA 架构或训练方式，核心是数据选择策略。
summary.experiments: 从 32M 池中仅选 1.49M（<5%）样本用于训练/后训练，相比等量随机采样把总体成功率从 47.7% 提升到 61.1%；摘要未给出 VLA 规模、具体基线名称与任务集合细节。

summary_en.core_problem: How to mine a small but truly useful subset of large-scale egocentric human videos for robot demonstration / embodied VLA post-training, instead of indiscriminate mixing.
summary_en.importance: A data selection/curriculum contribution: frames data choice as retrieval-and-ranking and shows “less but curated” beats “more but random” under a strong equal-budget control; mainly embodied, but conceptually relevant to pretraining data curation and mixture design.
summary_en.technical_approach: SiMDex uses a three-stage recall–ranking–re-ranking pipeline to retrieve task-relevant human egocentric clips from a ~32M pool for each robot demonstration, operating in a morphology-agnostic action space without changing the VLA architecture/training recipe.
summary_en.experiments: Uses only 1.49M mined samples (<5% of 32M) and improves overall success rate from 47.7% to 61.1 versus an equal-size random-sampling baseline; model size/baseline details are not in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把“数据配比”落到可执行的检索/重排管线，并给了强对照提升；但偏具身后训练，预训练侧只取其 data mining 思路。
recommendation.en: Good, actionable retrieval/rerank data-mining pipeline with a clean equal-budget control; still embodied post-training—borrow the curation idea, not the task specifics.

paper.title: Caching for the Future: Scrub Jay Episodic Memory Principles for Agent Memory Systems
paper.abstract: LLM agents that persist across sessions accumulate stored memories whose validity varies enormously by content type, yet existing memory architectures treat all memories as equally persistent and systematically contaminate retrieved context with outdated facts. We show that per-memory, type-conditioned temporal decay, a property of western scrub jay episodic memory, can be operationalized as an auto-classified coefficient $π_i$ in an external LLM-agent memory store, yielding ScrubJay-MEM: each m

summary.core_problem: 长期运行的 LLM agent 会积累大量记忆，但不同记忆的时效性差异很大，统一持久化会把过期事实带入检索上下文。
summary.importance: 贡献是 agent memory 方法和一个时间泛化评测。它把记忆的 perishability 显式建模为检索和更新信号，对长时程 agent 的上下文污染问题有参考意义，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ScrubJay-MEM，借鉴 scrub jay episodic memory 的时间衰减原则。每条记忆被编码为 What-Where-When tuple，并自动估计类型相关的 perishability 系数 π_i 和 utility horizon τ_i；检索时使用 query-adaptive scoring，更新时用 O(1) LLM calls 做 retroactive revision。
summary.experiments: 作者引入 Temporal Generalization Test，包含 held-out retention intervals，并用 Generalization Gap 衡量跨时间间隔泛化。在 TGT 上，ScrubJay-MEM 是唯一取得明显正 GenGap 的检索式系统，数值为 +0.108；摘要还提到在 MemoryAgentBench EventQA-64k 上评测，但截断信息未给完整结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani。

summary_en.core_problem: Persistent LLM agents accumulate memories whose validity decays at different rates, and treating all memories as equally persistent pollutes retrieved context with stale facts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-memory method plus a temporal-generalization benchmark. It is relevant to long-running agents and context contamination, but it is only indirectly connected to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ScrubJay-MEM operationalizes scrub-jay-like episodic memory. Each memory is represented as a What-Where-When tuple with an auto-classified perishability coefficient π_i and a utility horizon τ_i. Retrieval uses query-adaptive scoring, and retroactive memory revision is performed with O(1) LLM calls per update.
summary_en.experiments: The paper introduces the Temporal Generalization Test with held-out retention intervals and a Generalization Gap metric. On TGT, ScrubJay-MEM is reported as the only retrieval-based system with substantially positive GenGap, +0.108. The abstract also mentions MemoryAgentBench EventQA-64k, but the provided text is truncated before full results.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和 TGT 设计即可；时间衰减记忆是合理工程假设，但对预训练侧只提供弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and TGT setup; type-conditioned decay is a sane memory heuristic, but it gives only a weak signal for pretraining research.

institutions: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani

paper.title: AgentMemBench: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Term Memory Management Strategies in Conversational AI Agents
paper.abstract: Long-term memory remains a critical bottleneck for conversational AI agents, whose finite context windows cannot support coherent recall across thousands of turns. We present AgentMemBench, a unified, reproducible benchmark evaluating five memory management strategies under identical conditions: in-context windowing (ICW), external key-value store (EKV), graph-based episodic memory (GEM), compression-based summarisation (CBS), and web-augmented memory (WAM). All are assessed across three public

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 conversational agent 的长期记忆评测问题：在有限上下文窗口下，不同记忆管理策略如何影响跨会话召回、回答质量、忠实性和部署开销。
summary.importance: 它不是预训练方法论文，更接近 agent memory 的评测资产。对基座研究员的启发在于，它把长上下文、检索记忆、摘要压缩、图结构记忆和外部 Web 记忆放在同一 harness 下比较，可以帮助判断哪些能力应该靠模型上下文长度扩展解决，哪些更适合交给外部 memory system。对 long-context pretrain 和 agent post-train 也有间接价值：如果训练或评测只看最终回答质量，而不看 memory footprint、token cost、latency 和检索 provenance，很容易高估某些记忆策略的实际可用性。
summary.technical_approach: AgentMemBench 统一实现并评测五类记忆策略：ICW，即 in-context windowing，只保留最近 k 个 token 或 turn；EKV，即 external key-value store，把历史片段编码成 embedding 后做近邻检索；GEM，即 graph-based episodic memory，从对话中抽取实体和关系，维护结构化记忆图；CBS，即 compression-based summarisation，用自然语言摘要压缩旧上下文；WAM，即 web-augmented memory，用 Web search 或 MCP 工具补充外部信息。评测覆盖三个公开数据集：LoCoMo 200 个问题 turn，MultiDoc2Dial 187 个问题 turn，MSC 104 个问题 turn，总计 491 个标注问题 turn，形成 5 种策略 × 3 类任务的 15 个配置。指标包括 Memory Recall@k、MRR、nDCG@k、Answer F1、LLM-judge Faithfulness，以及 token cost、latency、memory footprint 等部署效率指标。一个方法细节比较关键：每个检索结果都带有真实的 session/turn provenance，因此 Recall/MRR/nDCG 是按 gold-session 标注评分，而不是按检索索引做近似匹配。论文还把 MemGPT/Letta 和 HippoRAG 放进同一 harness，并提出 MADS，一个零样本 Memory-Adaptive Dynamic Selector，根据四个语料统计量选择记忆策略。
summary.experiments: 实验规模是 491 个标注问题 turn、3 个数据集、5 类主策略，并补充两个已有外部记忆系统。论文报告的总体趋势是：ICW 在需要召回很早会话时容易失败，因为相关信息已被截断；EKV 和 CBS 对长程事实召回更稳，前者依赖语义检索，后者依赖摘要是否保留关键信息；GEM 更偏 precision-over-recall，能提供结构化关联，但在信息抽取不完整或关系稀疏时会漏掉答案所需事实；WAM 更适合需要外部知识补充的场景，但它不等价于内部长期记忆，并引入额外延迟和工具调用成本。MADS 被定位为部署启发式，而不是保证最优的选择器；论文也分析了它与经验最优策略不一致的场景。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。先看五类 memory strategy 的定义，确认各策略的输入、写入、检索和上下文拼接方式是否公平。然后看 provenance-aware retrieval evaluation 的指标设计，这是比普通 agent memory benchmark 更值得注意的部分。结果部分建议重点看不同数据集上的质量—成本权衡，而不是只看 Answer F1。MADS 部分适合快速浏览，主要价值在于把任务统计量和记忆策略选择联系起来；如果研究 long-context pretrain 或 agent memory training，可以重点关注哪些失败来自模型能力，哪些失败来自记忆写入和检索机制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses long-term memory evaluation for conversational agents. The question is how different memory-management strategies behave when an agent must recall information across many sessions while operating under a finite context window.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory benchmark rather than a pretraining contribution. Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but useful: it separates model context length from external memory design, and it evaluates not only answer quality but also retrieval quality, faithfulness, memory footprint, token cost, and latency. That matters for long-context training and agent post-training because a memory strategy that improves final-answer F1 may still be unattractive if it inflates context, retrieval latency, or tool-call cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgentMemBench implements five memory families under one harness. ICW keeps only a recent in-context window. EKV stores conversation snippets in an external key-value memory and retrieves them by dense similarity. GEM extracts entities and relations into an episodic knowledge graph, then retrieves structured neighborhoods. CBS compresses older context into natural-language summaries. WAM augments the agent with external web or MCP-style tool access. The benchmark uses three public datasets: 200 question turns from LoCoMo, 187 from MultiDoc2Dial, and 104 from MSC, for 491 annotated question turns in total. This yields 15 main configurations across five strategies and three task types. The metrics cover retrieval quality, including Memory Recall@k, MRR, and nDCG@k; answer quality, including Answer F1 and an LLM-judge faithfulness score; and deployment efficiency, including memory footprint, token cost, and latency. A notable design choice is provenance-aware retrieval evaluation: retrieved items carry true session/turn provenance, so retrieval metrics are computed against gold-session annotations rather than against ad-hoc retrieval indices. The paper also evaluates MemGPT/Letta and HippoRAG in the same harness and introduces MADS, a zero-shot dynamic selector that chooses a memory strategy from four corpus-level statistics.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates 491 annotated question turns across three datasets and five core memory strategies, with additional comparisons to published memory systems. The reported qualitative pattern is consistent with the expected failure modes of each design. ICW fails on questions whose evidence has fallen outside the recent window. EKV and CBS are stronger for long-range factual recall: EKV depends on semantic retrieval quality, while CBS depends on whether summaries preserve the needed details. GEM tends to be more selective, giving higher-precision structured recall but missing facts when extraction is incomplete or the graph neighborhood is sparse. WAM can help when external knowledge is needed, but it should not be treated as a replacement for internal conversational memory because it adds tool latency and cost. MADS is presented as a deployment heuristic rather than an optimal policy, and the paper explicitly examines cases where its selected strategy diverges from the empirically best one.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the definitions of the five memory strategies and check how memory is written, retrieved, and injected into the model context. Then read the provenance-aware metric design, since that is the cleanest methodological contribution. In the results, focus on quality-cost trade-offs across datasets rather than only final Answer F1. The MADS section is useful if the goal is to design adaptive memory policies. For long-context or agent-training work, the most useful lens is to separate model failures from memory-system failures: truncation, missing writes, weak retrieval, lossy summarization, and incomplete graph extraction have different implications for training data and architecture choices.

recommendation.zh: 读结果表就够；若 EKV 真压过 graph memory，很多复杂记忆系统要重新证明必要性。
recommendation.en: The result tables are enough; if EKV really beats graph memory, many complex memory systems need to re-justify their existence.

paper.title: Douyin Multimodal Embedding Model Technical Report
paper.abstract: Multimodal representation learning is a cornerstone of modern AI. By encoding multimodal queries and targets into vectors, it powers industrial search and recommendation and underpins modern agents. Real-world platforms with complex modalities and massive-scale content, such as Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and YouTube, demand both efficiency under billion-scale indexing and fine-grained discrimination for hard matching. Existing MLLM embedding models rarely satisfy both. Contrastive models are efficient

summary.core_problem: 工业级多模态检索中，对比学习的 MLLM embedding 模型效率高但区分粒度粗（pair-level 监督不告诉模型为什么相关），而基于显式 CoT 的模型区分能力强但推理延迟高，无法在十亿级索引系统中在线部署。需要同时满足低延迟和细粒度语义区分。
summary.importance: 对多模态表示学习有工程参考价值，latent reasoning 的思路（在隐空间做推理而非显式生成文本）对统一建模有一定启发。但论文核心是检索/推荐系统的 embedding 训练，属于工业应用导向，与 LLM 基座预训练研究的核心问题关联较弱。
summary.technical_approach: DME 提出在 bi-encoder 框架内做 latent reasoning：在生成 embedding token 之前，模型在隐空间产生推理 token（不显式解码为文本），从而以单次编码的代价获得细粒度区分能力。同时引入 cross-conditional generative supervision，补充对比学习的 pair-level 监督，让模型学习局部证据与匹配依据。骨干网络基于 Qwen3-VL / Qwen3.5。
summary.experiments: 在 MMEB-v2 benchmark 上，DME 在 2B 和 9B 两个规模均优于其他 embedding 模型，在 video 和 visual-document 检索上增益尤为显著。论文 Figure 1 给出了 overall 和分 domain（Image/Video/VisDoc）的对比结果。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看 Figure 2 的三种范式对比图（VLM2Vec vs CoT-VLM2Vec vs DME），能快速理解 latent reasoning 的设计动机。Introduction 中对对比学习与 CoT 方法张力的分析值得一读。若不关注检索系统，可跳过后续训练细节和工业部署部分。预计泛读 10-15 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 字节跳动 Douyin 团队

summary_en.core_problem: In industrial multimodal retrieval, contrastive MLLM embedding models are efficient but coarse-grained (pair-level supervision does not specify why items are relevant), while explicit CoT-based models offer fine-grained discrimination at inference latency too high for billion-scale online serving. Both low latency and fine-grained semantic discrimination are needed simultaneously.
summary_en.importance: Engineering reference for multimodal representation learning; the idea of latent reasoning (reasoning in hidden space rather than explicit text generation) has some relevance to unified modeling. However, the core contribution is embedding training for retrieval/recommendation systems, which is application-oriented and only weakly connected to core LLM pretraining research questions.
summary_en.technical_approach: DME performs latent reasoning within a bi-encoder framework: before producing the embedding token, the model generates reasoning tokens in latent space without decoding them to text, obtaining fine-grained discrimination at single-pass encoding cost. It also introduces cross-conditional generative supervision to complement contrastive pair-level supervision, teaching the model to capture local evidence and matching rationale. The backbone is based on Qwen3-VL / Qwen3.5.
summary_en.experiments: On MMEB-v2, DME outperforms other embedding models at both 2B and 9B scales, with particularly large gains on video and visual-document retrieval. Figure 1 shows overall and per-domain (Image, Video, VisDoc) comparisons.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Figure 2 for the three-paradigm comparison (VLM2Vec vs CoT-VLM2Vec vs DME), which quickly conveys the design motivation for latent reasoning. The Introduction's analysis of the tension between contrastive and CoT-based methods is worth reading. Readers not focused on retrieval systems can skip later training details and industrial deployment sections. Estimated skim time: 10-15 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Douyin (ByteDance) team

recommendation.zh: 读训练两阶段和 hard negative 设计即可；它更像工业 embedding recipe，不会直接改变基座 LM 训练范式。
recommendation.en: Read the two-stage training and hard-negative design; this is more an industrial embedding recipe than a change to base LM pretraining.

paper.title: Illuminating Visual Identity in Universal Multimodal Embeddings
paper.abstract: Universal Multimodal Embeddings (UMEs) aim to unify various modalities and tasks into a shared representation space. In recent years, this field has witnessed substantial progress driven by the development of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). However, a crucial capability, visual identity discrimination, remains underexplored in existing UME methods, despite its critical role in a wide range of tasks, including instance retrieval, re-identification, and identity preservation in AI-genera

summary.core_problem: 解决通用多模态 embedding 对视觉身份区分能力评测不足的问题，尤其是实例检索、重识别和生成内容身份保持中的 identity discrimination。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏 benchmark 和表示学习。它把 visual identity discrimination 作为 UME 的一个缺口单独定义，并构建 MVEB，用真实和合成数据支持评测与训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VisID 的统一任务表述，并发布 Multimodal Visual Identity Embedding Benchmark。方法上还给出一个联合优化框架，同时学习通用多模态表示和视觉身份表示；从摘要看更像在现有 UME/MLLM 表示体系上补齐 identity 维度。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 名称或具体提升幅度。实验应围绕 MVEB 上的身份判别、实例检索、re-identification 和 identity preservation 能力展开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the missing visual identity discrimination capability in universal multimodal embeddings, especially for instance retrieval, re-identification, and identity preservation in generated content.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a benchmark and representation-learning formulation. It defines VisID as a distinct evaluation axis for UMEs and introduces MVEB, built from real-world and synthetic datasets.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes a unified formulation for visual identity discrimination and a learning framework that jointly optimizes general multimodal representations and identity-sensitive visual representations. The work appears to extend existing UME/MLLM embedding systems rather than introduce a new foundation-model training paradigm.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, training scale, baseline names, or numerical gains. Evaluation is centered on MVEB and visual identity tasks such as retrieval, re-ID, and identity preservation.

recommendation.zh: 这是 UME 的身份维度补洞，适合作为多模态 embedding 评测备查；不必读训练细节。
recommendation.en: This fills an identity-evaluation gap for UMEs; keep it as a multimodal embedding benchmark reference, but skip the training details.

paper.title: ReLoop-UME: Recurrent Depth with Learnable Retrieval Registers for Universal Multimodal Embedding
paper.abstract: Universal multimodal embedding (UME) maps heterogeneous multimodal inputs into a shared embedding space. Existing UME models either form embeddings through single forward encoding or add computation through explicit rationale tokens and latent autoregressive states. Although token expansion can improve complex matching, serial generation increases retrieval latency and makes the final embedding depend on generated intermediate states. This raises a different question: can useful computation be e

summary.core_problem: 现有通用多模态嵌入（UME）模型要么单次前向计算不足，要么通过扩展token/自回归潜状态增加计算但带来高延迟，且嵌入依赖中间生成状态。
summary.importance: 方法改进+机制观察；首次系统分析UME模型各层的正负相似性分离演化阶段，提出固定token workspace下通过深度循环扩展计算的思路。
summary.technical_approach: 首先分析独立训练的UME模型各层的正负样本相似性分离规律，发现「早期上下文建模-中晚期检索判别特征形成-末期嵌入映射」的三阶段演化；据此提出ReLoop-UME，早期层仅执行一次，循环复用参数共享的中晚期层扩展计算深度，保持token数量不变。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露实验结果，核心验证多模态检索任务下的性能与延迟权衡。
summary.authors_note: 中科院自动化所、清华大学团队；无知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing universal multimodal embedding (UME) models either suffer from insufficient computation in single forward passes, or incur high latency and state-dependent embeddings when expanding computation via extra tokens or autoregressive latent states.
summary_en.importance: Methodological improvement plus mechanistic observation; first systematic analysis of layer-wise similarity separation dynamics in UME models, and a novel approach to expand computation along depth while fixing token workspace.
summary_en.technical_approach: First analyze layer-wise positive-negative similarity separation in independently trained UME models, identifying a three-stage progression: early contextualization, mid-to-late retrieval discriminative feature formation, and final embedding projection. ReLoop-UME runs early layers once and recurrently reuses parameter-shared mid-to-late layers to increase computation depth without growing token count.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental details are not available in the truncated abstract; core evaluations focus on performance-latency tradeoffs on multimodal retrieval tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Institute of Automation, CAS and Tsinghua University; no widely recognized senior authors.

recommendation.zh: 通用多模态嵌入的增量方法，层演化三阶段观察对理解多模态表示形成有微弱参考，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental work on universal multimodal embedding; the three-stage layer evolution observation is of marginal reference for multimodal representation research, just read the abstract.

institutions: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: Zero-Mem: Zero-Token Memory Operations for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: LLM agents need memory to act consistently over long interactions, yet many systems use additional LLM calls to operate that memory. Generating intermediate records and mediating their retrieval adds recurring token and time costs, while omitted or merged details can obscure the original evidence. We ask whether structured memory access requires generation at all. Zero-Mem introduces \emph{zero-token memory operations}: no step outside final question answering invokes an LLM or consumes LLM inpu

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 长时交互中，记忆读写依赖额外 LLM 调用而带来的 token、时延和证据失真问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于 agent memory 系统设计，而不是基座预训练；价值在于提出一种不经生成步骤的结构化记忆操作范式，对外部记忆与上下文组织有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Zero-Mem，把原始交互轨迹直接作为唯一记忆源，不在最终问答之外调用 LLM。系统用两种互补结构组织记忆：entity-context graph 捕捉跨轮实体关系，temporal hierarchy 保留会话局部性与时间顺序；查询时在两种视图间加权检索并沿结构恢复证据。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整 benchmark 名称和具体数值，但声称在多种长期记忆任务上，相比需要额外 LLM 记忆操作的方案，能显著降低 token 与时间成本，同时保持或提升回答质量。由于缺少更细的实验设定，结论更适合作为系统思路参考。
summary.authors_note: 香港理工大学、吉林大学、西南财经大学等合作；不是一线基座实验室，但问题设定贴近 agent memory 的实际系统成本。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the token, latency, and evidence-distortion overhead caused by using extra LLM calls for memory operations in long-horizon LLM agents.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory systems paper rather than a foundation-model pretraining contribution; its value lies in showing that structured memory access may not need generation at all.
summary_en.technical_approach: Zero-Mem treats raw interaction traces as the sole source of memory and avoids any LLM call outside final answering. It organizes memory with two complementary structures: an entity-context graph for cross-interaction relations and a temporal hierarchy for locality and session state; retrieval dynamically combines both views.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not expose full benchmark details or exact numbers, but claims strong reductions in token and time cost while preserving or improving answer quality on long-memory tasks compared with memory systems that rely on extra LLM operations. The evidence is more useful as a systems idea than as a clean scientific result.
summary_en.authors_note: A collaboration involving The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Jilin University, and Southwestern University of Finance and Economics; not a frontier pretraining lab, but the problem is practically relevant for agent memory systems.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 本身帮助不大，但它提醒你很多“记忆能力”其实是系统检索问题；只看结构设计，别把结果误读成模型内生记忆提升。
recommendation.en: Not very useful for pretraining itself, but it is a good reminder that much of “memory” is a systems retrieval problem; read the structure design, not as evidence of improved intrinsic model memory.

institutions: Southwestern University of Finance and Economics

paper.title: ViSAGE: Constructing Self-Correcting Memories for Long-Form Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Multimodal agents operating in long-horizon environments must build and continually update multimedia memories to support entity-consistent, temporally grounded reasoning. However, existing agentic memory approaches often discard fine-grained dentity cues under aggressive compression and segment-wise processing. They also rely heavily on vector similarity retrieval, which can surface semantically related yet identity-mismatched evidence, leading to entity confusion, error propagation, and halluc

summary.core_problem: 解决长视频理解中多模态 agent 记忆压缩后丢失细粒度实体线索、检索时发生身份混淆并导致幻觉的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态 agent 记忆方法创新。它关注 long-horizon multimodal memory 的实体一致性，对通用 agent 记忆和视频推理有参考意义，但不是预训练方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ViSAGE，一个自校正、实体中心的多模态记忆框架。它通过长时间跨度的跨模态绑定固定实体身份；用双向记忆 refinement 将延迟出现的身份线索向历史记录回传，并改善未来检索；再用多 agent cross-verification 根据 identity-evidence alignment 检查检索证据。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集、baseline 或具体提升。实验应评估长视频理解中的实体一致性、检索证据质量和问答幻觉率，但具体数值无法从给定信息确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets entity confusion in long-form video understanding, where compressed multimodal memories lose fine-grained identity cues and retrieval returns semantically related but identity-mismatched evidence.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal-agent memory method. It is relevant to long-horizon agent memory and video reasoning, but it does not directly contribute to pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: ViSAGE builds self-correcting, entity-centric multimodal memories. It anchors identity through cross-modal binding over long temporal ranges, applies bidirectional memory refinement to propagate delayed identity evidence backward and forward, and uses multi-agent cross-verification to assess retrieved evidence under an identity-evidence alignment criterion.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The likely evaluation axes are entity consistency, retrieval evidence quality, and hallucination reduction in long-form video understanding.

recommendation.zh: 这是 agent memory 的可用设计，不是预训练论文；只看实体绑定和反向修正机制，别被 video setting 带偏。
recommendation.en: This is a usable agent-memory design, not a pretraining paper; skim the entity binding and backward-refinement mechanism without over-indexing on the video setting.

paper.title: Memory Decoder at Scale: A Pretrained, Parametric Long-Term Memory
paper.abstract: Decoder-only language models entangle long-term memory and reasoning in a single parameter set, making it difficult to scale memory capacity independently. Memory Decoder introduces a parametric long-term memory module but only studies it at a relatively small scale. In this work, we present Memory Decoder at Scale, scaling memory models up to 6.9B parameters and pretraining them on 300B tokens. At this data scale, the combined cost of indexing and search makes a standard Faiss pipeline infeasib

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是 decoder-only LM 中长期知识记忆和推理计算共享同一套参数的问题。标准做法只能通过扩大 backbone 或继续训练整个模型来增加知识容量，代价高，也容易带来遗忘和能力漂移。Memory Decoder 的思路是把长期记忆做成一个可独立预训练、可替换、可复用的参数化模块；这篇工作进一步回答一个关键问题：这种参数化 memory 在 300B token、数十亿参数规模上是否仍然有效，是否比单纯扩大 backbone 更有参数效率。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的价值在于，它把“知识容量如何扩展”从 backbone scaling 中拆出来了。实验显示，在固定或相近参数预算下，把更多参数分配给 memory，而不是全部放进基础模型，能获得更好的 benchmark 表现。这对 continual pretrain、领域适配和模块化 LM 都有直接启发：领域知识可以作为 memory 单独预训练并在推理时切换，而基础模型保持冻结，降低全模型继续训练的成本和风险。贡献量级不只是一个小模块实验，而是把 Memory Decoder 扩到 6.9B memory、300B token，并处理了大规模 kNN teacher 构建的工程瓶颈。需要注意的是，训练 memory 依赖非参数 kNN 分布作为教师，前处理成本很高；它提供的是一种更可控的参数分配路径，不等同于完全免费地增加知识。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三部分组成。第一，冻结一个基础 LM，同时训练一个参数化 memory。memory 和 base model 接收同一上下文，各自产生 next-token distribution，推理时用线性插值合成最终分布：p_final = (1 - alpha) p_theta + alpha p_mem。这样 memory 不需要改写 backbone 参数，也可以在不同领域之间替换。第二，memory 的训练目标不是普通 next-token CE 单独驱动，而是对齐 kNN-LM 产生的非参数分布。图中给出的目标是 beta KL + (1 - beta) CE：KL 让 memory 学习检索器在局部邻域中给出的 token 分布，CE 保持语言建模信号，避免只做软标签蒸馏。和 RAG 不同，它推理时不再检索外部文本；和 kNN-LM 不同，它把检索分布压进参数里，换取更简单的推理路径。第三，工作重点处理了大规模 kNN teacher 的构建问题。对 deduplicated Pile 的 207B token 建索引和搜索时，常规 Faiss pipeline 不可行，因此使用 embedding compression、index sharding、parallel search 的分布式 Faiss 流水线；训练 general memory 时还用 sparse kNN distribution storage，只保存稀疏的邻居分布，并通过 distributed streaming 按 batch 读取所需条目，避免把完整 kNN 分布常驻内存或磁盘热路径。
summary.experiments: 主要结果集中在 general memory scaling 和 domain memory 两组实验。general memory 最大扩到 6.9B 参数，预训练数据为 300B token；kNN teacher 来自 deduplicated Pile 的 207B token。Pythia-410M 单独在 17 个 benchmark 上平均分为 29.86，接入 6.9B general memory 后升到 37.34，略高于 Pythia-12B 的 37.24，同时总参数少 39%。图 1 还显示，在多个规模点上，小 backbone 加大 memory 的组合，比只扩大 backbone 有更好的参数-性能折中。domain memory 方面，使用 1.7B 参数的领域 memory，搭配 Qwen3 Base 0.6B 到 14B 的多个 backbone，在 BioInst、LawBench、FinEval 三个领域平均提升均超过 9 分。对 Qwen3-14B-Base，三个领域分别给出约 17.96、8.97 等幅度的提升，说明 memory 不只对小模型有用，在较大 backbone 上仍能提供增益。更关键的实验信号是参数分配：同样增加参数，把参数放到可训练 memory 中，至少在这些任务上比继续扩大基础模型更划算。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读图 1、图 2、memory training objective、distributed Faiss pipeline、scaling results 和 domain memory 部分。图 1 是核心结论，直接展示 memory scaling 相对 backbone scaling 的参数效率。图 2 是方法入口，要看清楚 base model、memory、retriever teacher 和插值分布之间的关系。方法部分重点看 KL+CE 为什么组合使用，以及 alpha、beta 这类超参如何影响 memory 和 backbone 的分工。工程部分值得细读，因为 207B token 级别 kNN 分布构建是这类方法能否扩展的关键。实验部分应重点看 memory size、base size、general/domain memory、不同领域之间的消融；真正值得深挖的问题是 memory 学到的是可泛化知识分布，还是对 kNN teacher 的压缩近似，以及这种压缩在更强 backbone 上的边际收益如何变化。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息显示为清华大学电子工程系，并关联 LUMIA-Group/MemoryDecoder-at-Scale 与 Rubin-wei/MemoryDecoder-at-Scale 代码仓库。作者邮箱包含 weirubinn@gmail.com 和 lin.zhouhan@gmail.com；从给定内容无法完整确认作者列表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a structural limitation of decoder-only language models: long-term memory and reasoning are stored in the same parameter set. Increasing knowledge capacity usually means scaling the whole backbone or continuing to train all parameters, which is expensive and can cause forgetting or unintended capability shifts. Memory Decoder separates long-term memory into a pretrained, swappable parametric module. This work tests whether that idea still works at a more realistic pretraining scale: up to 6.9B memory parameters and 300B training tokens.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is the parameter-allocation result. The paper provides evidence that, under a comparable parameter budget, assigning parameters to an independently trained memory can be more efficient than putting all additional parameters into the backbone. This has direct implications for continual pretraining, domain adaptation, and modular language models. Domain knowledge can be trained as a separate memory and swapped at inference while the base model remains frozen. The contribution is not only architectural; it also shows how to build the kNN teacher distributions at 207B-token scale. A caveat is that the memory is trained from a non-parametric kNN teacher, so the offline indexing and search cost is substantial. The result should be read as a credible path for decoupling knowledge capacity from reasoning capacity, not as a cost-free replacement for backbone scaling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method combines a frozen base LM with a separately pretrained parametric memory. At inference, both modules process the same context and produce next-token distributions. The final prediction is an interpolation: p_final = (1 - alpha) p_theta + alpha p_mem. The memory is trained to imitate a kNN-LM distribution while retaining a standard next-token objective. The loss shown in the paper is beta KL + (1 - beta) CE: the KL term aligns the memory with the non-parametric retriever distribution, and the CE term preserves direct language-modeling supervision. Compared with RAG, the approach does not retrieve external passages at inference. Compared with kNN-LM, it compresses the retrieval distribution into parameters. The scaling work is enabled by a distributed Faiss pipeline with embedding compression, index sharding, and parallel search. For general memory pretraining, sparse kNN distribution storage and distributed streaming are used so that each batch only loads the required distribution entries.
summary_en.experiments: The largest general memory has 6.9B parameters and is pretrained on 300B tokens. The kNN teacher is built over the 207B-token deduplicated Pile. On 17 benchmarks, Pythia-410M alone scores 29.86 on average. With a 6.9B general memory, it reaches 37.34, slightly above Pythia-12B at 37.24 while using 39% fewer total parameters. Figure 1 also shows the same pattern across several scale points: a smaller backbone paired with a larger memory gives a better parameter-performance tradeoff than backbone-only scaling. For domain memory, 1.7B memories are paired with Qwen3 Base models from 0.6B to 14B. Across BioInst, LawBench, and FinEval, the average gain is more than 9 points at every backbone scale. On Qwen3-14B-Base, the reported domain gains include 17.96 and 8.97 points for two of the domains, indicating that the memory still helps even when the backbone is already large.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Figure 1, Figure 2, the memory training objective, the distributed Faiss pipeline, the scaling experiments, and the domain-memory experiments carefully. Figure 1 contains the central scaling claim. Figure 2 explains the mechanics: base model, memory, retriever teacher, and distribution interpolation. The method section is useful for understanding why KL alignment is paired with CE instead of using only next-token prediction or only teacher distillation. The systems section matters because the 207B-token kNN teacher is the practical bottleneck. In the experiments, focus on memory size versus backbone size, general versus domain memories, and ablations around interpolation and training objectives. The key question to keep in mind is whether the memory is learning broadly reusable knowledge distributions or mainly compressing the behavior of a particular kNN teacher.
summary_en.authors_note: The affiliation shown in the provided content is the Department of Electronic Engineering, Tsinghua University. The project is associated with LUMIA-Group/MemoryDecoder-at-Scale and Rubin-wei/MemoryDecoder-at-Scale. The visible emails include weirubinn@gmail.com and lin.zhouhan@gmail.com; the complete author list cannot be confirmed from the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你对“参数该给 backbone 还是给 memory”的 prior；先看 tradeoff 表和 retrieval 系统设计，再决定是否在内部做 memory-budget ablation。
recommendation.en: This can change your prior on whether extra parameters should go to the backbone or to memory; read the tradeoff tables and retrieval-system section first, then decide if a memory-budget ablation is worth running internally.

paper.title: Gradient-free Task-Conditioned Retrieval for On-Device In-Context Learning
paper.abstract: On-device in-context learning (ICL) relies on pre-inference retrieval to select demonstrations for useful context before downstream model inference. This retrieval must exploit task-specific information while operating over local memories under limited computation, memory, and data-exposure budgets. We propose Conditional Retrieval Alignment (CoRA), a gradient-free framework that converts a frozen encoder into a task-conditioned retriever using paired candidate inputs and outputs. CoRA selects c

summary.core_problem: 在端侧 ICL 场景中，如何在不能训练模型、计算和隐私预算有限的条件下，为当前任务检索更合适的 demonstrations。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 RAG/ICL 检索方法改进。它不直接改变预训练方法，但触及一个有用问题：上下文示例选择是否能用轻量闭式方法获得任务条件化，而不依赖梯度更新或在线访问输出标签。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Conditional Retrieval Alignment，简称 CoRA。方法冻结 encoder，用候选输入-输出对构造任务条件空间；选择互补 encoder 层，通过闭式 ridge regression 将候选输入表示对齐到由输出派生的空间；再用低秩分解得到紧凑检索基。候选输出只在离线建索引时使用，查询时只需输入和预计算索引。
summary.experiments: 摘要称给出了 rank-constrained basis 的最优低秩压缩性质，并在端侧 ICL 检索任务中验证。公开摘要未提供具体任务、模型、设备预算、baseline 或提升幅度，需要正文确认是否只是 retrieval reranking 的常规增量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses task-specific demonstration retrieval for on-device ICL under frozen-model, limited-compute, limited-memory, and data-exposure constraints.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a retrieval method for RAG/ICL. It does not directly affect pretraining, but it is relevant to how lightweight task conditioning can be obtained without gradient updates or online access to candidate labels.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Conditional Retrieval Alignment, or CoRA. A frozen encoder is adapted by using paired candidate inputs and outputs: complementary encoder layers are selected, an output-derived conditioning space is built, input representations are aligned to that space via closed-form ridge regression, and low-rank factorization yields a compact retrieval basis. Candidate outputs are used only during offline indexing; query-time retrieval uses only the input and precomputed index.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states an optimal low-rank compression result for the rank-constrained basis and reports empirical validation for on-device ICL retrieval. It does not provide task lists, model sizes, hardware budgets, baselines, or gains, so the full paper is needed to judge whether the result is more than incremental reranking.

recommendation.zh: 作为端侧 ICL 检索备查即可；重点看 ridge 对齐的闭式推导，实验若缺少强 retriever baseline 就别过度解读。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for on-device ICL retrieval; read the closed-form ridge alignment, but do not overread the results without strong retriever baselines.

paper.title: DenseOn with the LateOn: Fully Open Dense and Late-Interaction Models for Multilingual, Long-Context, and Code Search
paper.abstract: State-of-the-art retrieval models increasingly rely on closed training data, creating a reproducibility gap. We present an open end-to-end recipe for training retrieval models and study how English supervision transfers to multilingual retrieval through translate-train. We first reconstruct and curate 665M English contrastive pre-training pairs from 1.4B pairs across 34 public sources and build 1.88M supervised fine-tuning pairs with mined hard negatives. Training yields two 149M-parameter model

summary.core_problem: 构建完全开放的检索模型训练配方，缓解强检索器依赖闭源训练数据导致的可复现性问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是数据与训练 recipe：公开重建大规模对比预训练对、监督微调对和 hard negatives，并比较 dense 与 late-interaction 检索器在多语言、长上下文和代码检索中的迁移行为。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从 34 个公开来源的 14 亿英文 pair 中重建和清洗 6.65 亿对比预训练 pair，再构建 188 万监督微调 pair 和 mined hard negatives；训练 DenseOn 单向量 dense retriever 与 LateOn ColBERT-style late-interaction retriever，并通过 translate-train 扩展到 8 种语言和跨语言样本。
summary.experiments: 训练两个 149M 参数英文模型 DenseOn 和 LateOn，在 BEIR 上平均 nDCG@10 分别为 56.20 和 57.22，在同等规模段达到很强结果。多语言阶段产生 28 亿 pair，训练基于 mmBERT-base 的 307M 参数 mDenseOn 和 mLateOn。摘要称两者使用相同 backbone、数据和目标，但表示行为不同。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a fully open recipe for retrieval-model training to address the reproducibility gap caused by closed retriever training data.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is data and training recipe: large-scale reconstructed contrastive pairs, supervised fine-tuning pairs, mined hard negatives, and a comparison of dense versus late-interaction retrievers across multilingual, long-context, and code search.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors reconstruct and curate 665M English contrastive pretraining pairs from 1.4B pairs across 34 public sources, build 1.88M supervised fine-tuning pairs with hard negatives, and train DenseOn and LateOn. They then use translate-train to create multilingual and cross-lingual samples across eight languages.
summary_en.experiments: The English models are 149M parameters: DenseOn reaches 56.20 average nDCG@10 on BEIR and LateOn reaches 57.22. The multilingual setup contains 2.8B pairs and trains 307M-parameter mDenseOn and mLateOn on mmBERT-base. The abstract reports different representation behavior despite shared backbone, data, and objectives.

recommendation.zh: 检索器不是基座 LM，但开放数据清洗和 translate-train 配方可复用；看数据构建和 BEIR 表即可。
recommendation.en: Not base-LM work, but the open data curation and translate-train recipe are reusable; read data construction and BEIR tables.

paper.title: NEXT: Reasoning-Driven Video Recommendation via a Vision-Language Model
paper.abstract: We present NEXT (Next-interest EXploration Transformer), a reasoning-driven video recommendation framework that reasons over the video a user has just watched, infers the viewer's next intent, and retrieves concrete follow-up videos. Explicit continuations such as episodes are linked directly; implicit cases are handled by generating intent queries and searching for matching candidates. This Item-to-Intent-to-Item formulation produces directed recommendations beyond co-engagement correlation or

summary.core_problem: 用视觉语言模型理解用户刚看过的视频，推断下一步观看意图，并检索后续视频推荐。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是VLM驱动的推荐系统方法和任务定制训练流程。它把推荐从共现相关或语义相似转为“Item-to-Intent-to-Item”的显式推理链，但主要价值仍在视频推荐应用，不是通用基座预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出NEXT框架：显式续集直接链接，隐式续看需求由模型生成意图查询再检索候选视频。训练NEXT-8B时使用三阶段流程：Perception-Enhanced RL用于抽取与查询无关的视觉证据，Distribution-Aligned SFT混合真实和合成视觉QA数据，最后用GRPO做任务对齐。
summary.experiments: 摘要称NEXT-8B为8B视觉语言模型，在单模型DocVQA上取得最好结果，总榜仅次于一个多Agent系统；未给出推荐任务上的具体数据规模、baseline名称和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper uses a vision-language model to reason over a watched video, infer the user's next intent, and retrieve concrete follow-up videos.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an application-oriented VLM recommendation framework plus a task-specific training recipe. It reframes recommendation as Item-to-Intent-to-Item reasoning, but the core target remains video recommendation rather than general foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: NEXT directly links explicit continuations and handles implicit continuations by generating intent queries for retrieval. NEXT-8B is trained with Perception-Enhanced RL for query-agnostic evidence extraction, Distribution-Aligned SFT on real and synthetic visual QA mixtures, and GRPO for final alignment.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports an 8B VLM and claims best single-model DocVQA performance, second overall behind a multi-agent system. It does not provide detailed recommendation datasets, baselines, or effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 推荐系统外壳较重；若关心VLM后训练，只看三阶段recipe，别把推荐效果外推到通用能力。
recommendation.en: The recommender wrapper dominates; if you care about VLM post-training, only inspect the three-stage recipe and avoid over-reading the recommendation gains.

paper.title: Temporal Context Reinstatement Drives Episodic-Like Order Memory in Long-Context Language Models
paper.abstract: Human episodic memory supports the retrieval of experiences that unfold over extended timescales, yet the computational mechanisms underlying this ability remain debated due to the limited mechanistic accessibility in long-term memory experiments in humans. Long-context LLMs may offer promising ways to reveal plausible computational mechanisms that drive this type of retrieval. Here, we investigate whether and how LLMs capture the core behavioral signatures of episodic memory via a temporal orde

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究长上下文语言模型是否能表现出类似人类情景记忆的时间顺序记忆，并进一步追问模型内部靠什么机制完成这种判断：是显式的时间位置表征，还是仅靠语义、因果和叙事线索推断先后顺序。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在长上下文机制分析，而不是训练 recipe。论文把“长上下文是否真的在用时间结构”这个问题做成了可测、可干预的任务。结果指向一个重要现象：模型在长文本检索时不只是匹配语义片段，还会在检索阶段重建低维时间上下文。这对长上下文预训练、位置编码设计、KV-cache 记忆解释、长程评测设计都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文设计了 Sequence Order Recall Task，给定一部长篇文本中的两个不重叠 50 词片段，要求判断哪个片段在原文中更早出现。作者用完整小说构造人类行为数据，并让长上下文 LLM 在相同任务上评测。关键分析不是停留在行为相似性，而是进入模型内部：先定位隐藏状态中是否存在可线性读出的时间顺序信息，再分析 retrieval 阶段哪些 attention head 会从 KV-cache 中重新激活这种时间码。论文报告一个专门的 attention head 会重建低维 temporal code，并通过因果干预验证它对顺序判断有实际作用。这与“模型只是利用故事语义链推断顺序”的解释不同。
summary.experiments: 主要结果包括三点。第一，模型和人类都表现出 distance effect：两个片段在原文中距离越远，顺序判断越容易。第二，模型内部存在低维时间表征，可用于解释顺序判断表现。第三，某个特化 attention head 在 retrieval 阶段从 KV-cache 中恢复时间信息；对该 head 或相关表征做干预会影响 temporal order judgment。文中还发布 ICMemory-Kit，用于长上下文记忆与机制解释实验。给定材料中没有提供具体模型参数量、上下文长度、样本规模和干预幅度数字，阅读时需要到实验章节核对。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。优先看任务构造和人类数据部分，确认 SORT 是否排除了明显的语义捷径。然后看 temporal code 的定位方法，以及 attention head 的因果验证实验。最值得细读的是模型如何区分“时间上下文恢复”和“语义链推断”，因为这决定了结论对长上下文预训练是否有外推意义。若只关心工程启发，可重点看 attention/KV-cache 分析和 ICMemory-Kit 的接口设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether long-context language models exhibit human-like temporal order memory over extended naturalistic inputs, and what internal mechanism supports this behavior: an explicit temporal position code or inference from semantic and narrative structure.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is mechanistic insight into long-context memory. The work turns a vague question—whether a model actually uses temporal structure—into a controlled task with behavioral comparison and causal probing. The key implication is that long-context retrieval may rely on reinstating a low-dimensional temporal context, not only on matching semantic content. This matters for long-context pretraining, positional representation design, KV-cache analysis, and evaluation of memory over long documents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce the Sequence Order Recall Task. Given two non-overlapping 50-word passages sampled from a long text, the model or human subject must decide which one appeared earlier. They build a human behavioral dataset from memory of a full-length novel and compare it with long-context LLMs. The mechanistic part localizes temporal order information in model activations, then studies how this information is reinstated during retrieval. The paper reports that a specialized attention head retrieves a low-dimensional temporal code from the KV cache and that causal interventions on this mechanism affect order judgments. This distinguishes the proposed mechanism from a pure semantic-chain explanation.
summary_en.experiments: The reported findings are: models show the same distance effect observed in humans, where order judgments become easier as the two queried segments are farther apart in the original text; temporal order information can be localized in internal representations; and a specific attention head reinstates temporal information during retrieval and is causally involved in the task. The paper also releases ICMemory-Kit for long-context memory and interpretability experiments. The provided text does not include exact model sizes, context lengths, dataset sizes, or intervention effect sizes, so those numbers should be checked in the experimental sections.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the task and human dataset design to see how much semantic shortcutting is controlled. Then read the sections on temporal-code localization and attention-head causal intervention. The most important technical point is how the authors separate temporal context reinstatement from semantic inference. For engineering relevance, focus on the KV-cache analysis and the ICMemory-Kit design.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 方法论文，但如果你关心长上下文记忆机制，只看关键 head 干预和一维时间码那几节就够，能帮你判断 retrieval 到底像不像显式状态重建。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if long-context memory matters to you, read the head intervention and 1D temporal-code sections; they sharpen whether retrieval behaves like explicit state reinstatement.

institutions: The University of Texas at Austin

paper.title: SF-AMS: Strategic Forgetting for Structured Memory in LLM Agent
paper.abstract: Managing long-context dependencies remains a primary bottleneck in LLM agents, as redundant and irrelevant information can degrade multi-step reasoning. Strategic Forgetting for Agent Memory Systems (SF-AMS) is proposed as a framework for maintaining compact high-utility memory by modeling the long-term importance of memory units. SF-AMS replaces static retrieval and heuristic decay with a utility-driven survival mechanism that updates memory importance from usage redundancy and temporal signals

summary.core_problem: LLM agent 的长期记忆会积累冗余和无关信息，干扰多步推理和长上下文依赖处理。
summary.importance: 贡献是通用 agent memory 的工程方法：用 utility-driven forgetting 维护紧凑高效记忆。它对预训练没有直接作用，但对外部记忆、长上下文 agent 和 retrieval policy 设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: SF-AMS 用 utility-driven survival mechanism 替代静态检索和启发式衰减；记忆单元的重要性由使用频率、冗余度和时间信号动态更新，并形成层级记忆结构。Composite Importance Scoring 进一步结合语义信号和 entity-level 信号，提高检索稳定性。
summary.experiments: 在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-s 上，与 LightMem、MemO、A-Mem 等 agent memory baseline 比较。摘要报告在 Qwen2.5-7B 的 multi-hop reasoning 场景中，SF-AMS 相比最强 baseline 提升 +9.65 F1。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-term memory in LLM agents accumulates redundant and irrelevant information, which can hurt multi-step reasoning over long contexts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-memory engineering method based on utility-driven forgetting. It is not a pretraining method, but it is relevant to external memory, retrieval policy design, and long-context agent behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: SF-AMS replaces static retrieval and heuristic decay with a utility-driven survival mechanism. Memory-unit importance is updated from usage, redundancy, and temporal signals, inducing a hierarchical memory structure. Composite Importance Scoring combines semantic and entity-level cues for more robust retrieval.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-s against memory baselines including LightMem, MemO, and A-Mem. The abstract reports the largest gain in multi-hop reasoning with Qwen2.5-7B, where SF-AMS improves by 9.65 F1 over the strongest baseline.

recommendation.zh: 看 memory scoring 公式和 LoCoMo 表即可；像 agent memory 的工程整理，未改变长上下文 prior。
recommendation.en: Check the memory-scoring rule and LoCoMo table; this is useful agent-memory engineering, not a shift in long-context priors.

paper.title: LazyMem: Retrieve Broadly, Construct Selectively for Efficient Long-Term Agent Memory
paper.abstract: Long-term memory lets LLM agents reuse past interactions, but raw dialogue histories are verbose and information-sparse. Retrieving broadly improves evidence coverage yet overwhelms downstream reasoning with noise; compressing at write time reduces noise but irreversibly discards details the future query may need. We introduce LazyMem, which sidesteps this dilemma by deferring all memory construction to query time. A lightweight 4B model processes the retrieved candidate pool in overlapping para

summary.core_problem: LLM智能体长期记忆存在两难：广范围检索会带来噪声过载影响推理，写入时压缩则会不可逆丢失未来查询可能需要的细节信息。
summary.importance: 提出延迟构造记忆的新范式，属于方法创新，在保证记忆准确率的同时大幅降低了记忆token占用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出LazyMem方法，将所有记忆构造操作推迟到查询时执行；用4B参数轻量模型以重叠并行窗口处理检索候选池，仅选择性保留和压缩与当前查询相关的内容；训练流程为先SFT后分组RL，采用格式门控复合奖励（规则选择准确率信号+LLM评判的忠实度与效用信号）。
summary.experiments: 在LongMemEval基准上，LazyMem-4B达到0.85的LLM评判准确率，仅使用213个记忆token，比基线方法少68.7倍。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-term memory for LLM agents faces a dilemma: broad retrieval introduces noise overload that degrades reasoning, while write-time compression irreversibly discards details that future queries may need.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a new deferred memory construction paradigm, a methodological innovation that achieves high memory accuracy while drastically reducing memory token footprint.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces LazyMem, which defers all memory construction to query time; uses a 4B-parameter lightweight model to process retrieved candidate pools in overlapping parallel windows, selectively retaining and compressing only query-relevant content; training follows SFT followed by group-based RL with a format-gated composite reward (rule-based selection accuracy + LLM-judged faithfulness and utility).
summary_en.experiments: On the LongMemEval benchmark, LazyMem-4B achieves 0.85 LLM-judge accuracy with only 213 memory tokens, 68.7× fewer than baseline methods.

recommendation.zh: 查询时构造记忆的思路有启发，但属于agent工程优化，与预训练关联弱，看方法部分的奖励设计即可。
recommendation.en: Query-time memory construction is an interesting idea, but it's agent engineering with weak pretrain relevance; read the reward design section in methods only.

paper.title: Notes to Self: Can LLMs Benefit from Experiential Abstractions?
paper.abstract: Humans distill experience into reusable abstractions, e.g., strategies and cautionary reminders, and apply them to gradually solve problems more effectively. We study whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can similarly benefit from such experiential abstractions. From LLMs' solution traces on the MATH training set, a stronger teacher or the LLMs themselves extract natural-language abstractions into a retrievable library. We explore two usage modes: (1) inference-time retrieval and (2) reinforceme

summary.core_problem: LLM 能否像人类一样，把过往解题过程压缩成可复用的自然语言“经验抽象”，并在后续推理中持续受益。
summary.importance: 这项工作属于后训练与推理增强交界处。价值不在于又一个 retrieval trick，而在于把“从轨迹中提炼策略/提醒”作为训练信号，连接了 reasoning traces、经验记忆和 RL。对预训练研究员的启发是：模型可能不只需要更多轨迹，还需要更高层的可复用抽象。
summary.technical_approach: 作者从 MATH 训练集上的解题轨迹中，让强教师模型或模型自身提取自然语言 abstractions，构成可检索库。然后探索两种用法：一是在推理时检索相关抽象并加入 prompt；二是在 RL 训练中，把 abstraction-augmented prompts 作为额外上下文，让模型学会利用这些经验总结。论文还比较了 teacher-extracted 与 self-extracted abstractions 的效果与可迁移性。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明实验覆盖数学与逻辑推理 benchmark，且自提取抽象可接近教师提取抽象，说明经验压缩不完全依赖更强外部模型。未在摘要中给出具体模型规模、RL 算法细节、训练 token 数和提升幅度；从问题设定看，关键 baseline 应包括无抽象、普通 CoT、仅检索原始轨迹、以及仅 RL 不加抽象。若正文控制得当，最值得看的是 abstraction 粒度、检索命中率与跨数据集迁移。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Carnegie Mellon University 的 Auton Lab。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLMs can benefit from human-like experiential abstractions: reusable natural-language strategies and reminders distilled from prior solution traces.
summary_en.importance: This sits at the boundary of post-training and reasoning enhancement. The interesting part is not just retrieval, but treating distilled experience as a training signal, linking reasoning traces, memory, and RL. For pretraining researchers, it suggests that higher-level reusable abstractions may matter beyond simply adding more trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method extracts natural-language abstractions from solution traces on the MATH training set, using either a stronger teacher model or the model itself, and stores them in a retrievable library. Two usage modes are studied: retrieval at inference time, and RL with abstraction-augmented prompts during training. The paper also compares teacher-extracted versus self-extracted abstractions and studies transfer across datasets and models.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover mathematical and logical reasoning benchmarks. The abstract claims that self-extracted abstractions match teacher-extracted ones and that the framework transfers across datasets and models. It does not provide model sizes, RL details, token budgets, or exact gains. The key baselines should include no abstraction, standard CoT, retrieval of raw traces, and RL without abstraction. The most informative details will likely be abstraction granularity, retrieval hit quality, and transfer behavior.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Auton Lab at Carnegie Mellon University.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain prior，但对“轨迹监督该压缩成什么”提了个像样问题；先看 abstraction 提取模板和 RL 对比，若 baseline 干净可拿来做 reasoning memory ablation。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining priors, but it asks a real question about what trajectory supervision should be compressed into; read the abstraction extraction and RL comparisons, then consider a reasoning-memory ablation.

paper.title: VDAR-Router: Adaptive LLMs Routing via Verbalized Query Difficulty Analysis Retrieval
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in practical systems, making efficient model selection important for reducing deployment cost. LLM routing has emerged as a practical solution for allocating each input query to an appropriate model under a desired cost-performance trade-off. Existing routing methods often estimate model suitability from the surface semantics or embedding similarity of the input query. However, such methods may ignore the underlying difficulty of a query, leading to su

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 服务中按查询动态选择模型的问题，目标是在成本和效果之间做更细粒度的路由。
