paper.title: Draft Less, Retrieve More: Hybrid Tree Construction for Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model inference by leveraging a draft-then-verify paradigm. To maximize the acceptance rate, recent methods construct expansive draft trees, which unfortunately incur severe VRAM bandwidth and computational overheads that bottleneck end-to-end speedups. While dynamic-depth pruning can reduce this latency by removing marginal branches, it also discards potentially valid candidates, preventing the acceptance rate from reaching the upper bound of

summary.core_problem: 推测解码里，扩大 draft tree 能提高 acceptance rate，但会带来显著显存带宽和计算开销；剪枝虽省算力，却损失可接受候选，如何打破这组 trade-off。
summary.importance: 这是典型的高效推理工作，贡献在于把 speculative decoding 的资源分配问题显式化：不是一味做更大树，而是把剪枝省下的预算转给检索补偿。对 serving 和解码系统设计有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Graft，一个 prune-then-retrieve 的混合树构造框架。先对稠密 draft tree 做动态深度剪枝，释放显存带宽与计算预算；再用 retrieval 机制补回被剪掉但高概率会被 verifier 接受的候选，从而在更低成本下接近 dense tree 的 accepted length。核心思想是让 pruning 与 retrieval 形成互补：前者省预算，后者补 coverage。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型规模和数据集，但实验应围绕 speculative decoding 的端到端速度、acceptance rate、accepted length、VRAM bandwidth 与计算开销展开，对比 dense drafting、dynamic-depth pruning 等基线。论文的关键看点不是绝对速度数字，而是是否在相同资源预算下把 acceptance-length trade-off 向外推。

summary_en.core_problem: In speculative decoding, larger draft trees improve acceptance rate but incur severe VRAM-bandwidth and compute overhead; pruning saves cost but loses valid candidates. The paper asks how to break this trade-off.
summary_en.importance: This is a clean inference-efficiency paper. Its contribution is to frame speculative decoding as a resource-allocation problem: instead of always drafting bigger trees, spend the budget saved by pruning on retrieval-based compensation. That is directly relevant to serving and decoding system design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Graft, a hybrid prune-then-retrieve framework for tree construction. It first applies dynamic-depth pruning to a dense draft tree, freeing memory bandwidth and compute budget. It then uses retrieval to recover high-value candidates that were lost by pruning, aiming to preserve accepted length while keeping cost low. The key idea is complementarity: pruning saves budget, retrieval restores coverage.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes or datasets, but the evaluation likely focuses on end-to-end speculative decoding speedup, acceptance rate, accepted length, VRAM bandwidth, and compute overhead, against dense drafting and dynamic-depth pruning baselines. The main question is whether the method pushes out the acceptance-versus-cost frontier under matched resource budgets.

recommendation.zh: 这是推测解码里少见把“带宽预算怎么花”讲清楚的工作；读 trade-off 设定和 prune→retrieve 设计就够了，速度数字先别太当真，平台依赖会很重。
recommendation.en: One of the cleaner speculative decoding papers because it makes the bandwidth-allocation trade-off explicit; read the prune→retrieve design, but treat raw speedup numbers cautiously since they are hardware-sensitive.

paper.title: PEEK: Context Map as an Orientation Cache for Long-Context LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over long and recurring external contexts, like document corpora and code repositories. Across invocations, existing approaches preserve either the agent's trajectory, passive access to raw material, or task-level strategies. None of them preserves what we argue is most needed for repeated same-context workloads: reusable orientation knowledge (e.g., what the context contains, how it is organized, and which entities, constants, and schemas h

summary.core_problem: 长上下文 agent 在反复访问同一外部语料或代码库时，如何保留对上下文结构与有用实体的“定向知识”，而不只是保存历史轨迹或原始文档。
summary.importance: 这是长上下文 agent 的缓存设计问题。贡献点在于提出 orientation cache / context map 这一中间表示，介于原始上下文和任务轨迹之间。对预训练本身不直接，但对长期记忆、外部上下文压缩和 recurrent workload 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PEEK，把可复用的 orientation knowledge 压成一个小而常数大小的 context map，放入后续 prompt。系统包含 Distiller、Cartographer、Prioritizer 三个模块：从推理时信号中抽取可迁移知识，转成结构化编辑，再按缓存策略维护。目标是让 agent 在重复面对同一上下文时更快定位内容、组织结构、关键实体、常用 schema 等。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark 数字，但任务场景包括长文档语料和代码仓库上的 repeated same-context workloads。比较对象应包括保留轨迹、直接访问原始上下文、任务级策略缓存等方案。论文核心评估点大概率是提示长度固定下的任务成功率、检索效率或多轮调用性能。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Omar Khattab 与 Samuel Madden，分别与检索增强、系统和数据库方向有代表性工作；这类组合通常偏系统化 agent 设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how long-context agents can preserve reusable orientation knowledge about a recurring external context, rather than only storing trajectories or raw documents.
summary_en.importance: This is a cache-design paper for long-context agents. Its main contribution is the notion of an orientation cache or context map, an intermediate representation between raw context and task trajectories. It is not directly about pretraining, but it is relevant to memory, context compression, and repeated-workload settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: PEEK stores reusable orientation knowledge as a small constant-sized context map inserted into future prompts. The system has three modules: a Distiller that extracts transferable knowledge from inference-time signals, a Cartographer that turns it into structured edits, and a Prioritizer that maintains the cache under a policy. The goal is to help the agent quickly recover what the context contains, how it is organized, and which entities or schemas matter.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete numbers, but the target workloads involve recurring long-context settings such as document corpora and code repositories. Likely baselines include trajectory memory, passive access to raw context, and task-level strategy retention. The main metrics are likely task success under fixed prompt budget, retrieval efficiency, or repeated-invocation performance.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors include Omar Khattab and Samuel Madden, known for work in retrieval-augmented systems and data systems, which fits a systems-oriented agent design paper.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“缓存上下文结构而不是缓存 token”这个抽象挺干净；看系统图和 cache policy 即可，别指望它回答长上下文建模本身。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the abstraction is clean: cache context structure rather than tokens; read the system design and cache policy, not for answers about long-context modeling itself.

paper.title: XSearch: Explainable Code Search via Concept-to-Code Alignment
paper.abstract: Semantic code search has been widely adopted in both academia and industry. These approaches embed natural-language queries and code snippets into a shared embedding space and retrieve results based on vector similarity. Despit strong performance on benchmark datasets, they often suffer from poor explainability and generalization. Retrieved code may appear semantically similar yet miss critical functional requirements of the query, while providing no explanation of why the result was retrieved.

summary.core_problem: 现有语义代码搜索方法基于全局嵌入相似度匹配，存在两个核心问题：(1) 可解释性差——仅返回相似度分数，无法说明代码哪些部分满足查询的哪些功能需求；(2) 分布外泛化差——模型倾向于依赖函数名等浅层线索进行匹配，在测试分布变化时性能崩溃。这两个问题的根源在于现有方法的归纳匹配（inductive matching）范式：通过二元监督学习查询与代码的统计相关性，而非像开发者一样通过演绎验证（deductive validation）逐一检查功能需求是否被满足。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练研究的启发主要在建模范式层面。XSearch 提出的从「归纳匹配」到「演绎对齐」的转变，对通用检索增强 LLM（RALM）和代码预训练有一定借鉴意义：将查询分解为概念、再与目标文本的局部区域做显式对齐的思路，可能改善预训练中 cross-modal 对齐的可解释性和鲁棒性。不过该工作本身是代码搜索领域的方法改进，不直接修改 LLM 预训练架构或目标。
summary.technical_approach: XSearch 将代码搜索重新定义为概念到代码的对齐（concept-to-code alignment）问题。核心流程分三步：(1) 概念分解——将自然语言查询解析为多个功能概念（动作、实体、约束等）；(2) 局部匹配——识别代码中实现类似功能的显著片段（salient code spans）；(3) 最优对齐计算——通过概念到代码片段的最优对齐来排序候选代码并生成解释。关键设计是将概念对齐集成到训练和检索的全过程，使模型不依赖全局相似度，而是覆盖查询的多个功能维度。该方法在 GraphCodeBERT（约 125M 参数）上微调实现。
summary.experiments: 在 6 个 encoder-only 基线（CodeBERT, UniXCoder, GraphCodeBERT, CoCoSoDa, HedgeCode, RAPID）和 2 个 decoder-only 基线（Qwen2.5-Coder-7B, CodeLlama-7B）上进行对比。核心结果：在分布外基准上，基线方法性能几乎崩溃（MRR 低至 0.02），XSearch 将 MRR 提升至 0.33。用户研究显示，概念对齐解释使开发者接受/拒绝检索结果的速度快 38%，准确率高 10.5%。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，重点看 Introduction 中对归纳 vs 演绎范式差距的分析（第 3-4 页），以及实验部分的分布外泛化对比（表 2-3）。方法细节中的概念分解和对齐算法可快速浏览。全文约 30 分钟阅读量。
summary.authors_note: 未提供作者和机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing semantic code search methods rely on global embedding similarity matching, suffering from two core issues: (1) poor explainability—only returning similarity scores without indicating which code parts satisfy which functional requirements of the query; (2) poor out-of-distribution generalization—models tend to rely on shallow cues like function names for matching, leading to performance collapse when test distribution changes. The root cause is the inductive matching paradigm: learning statistical correlations between queries and code via binary supervision, instead of deductive validation where developers check each functional requirement explicitly.
summary_en.importance: The main启发 for LLM foundation pretraining is at the modeling paradigm level. XSearch's shift from 'inductive matching' to 'deductive alignment' offers some insights for retrieval-augmented LLM (RALM) and code pretraining: decomposing queries into concepts and explicitly aligning them with local regions in target text could potentially improve the explainability and robustness of cross-modal alignment in pretraining. However, this work itself is a method improvement in code search, not directly modifying LLM pretraining architecture or objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: XSearch reformulates code search as a concept-to-code alignment problem. The core pipeline has three steps: (1) concept decomposition—parsing natural language queries into multiple functional concepts (actions, entities, constraints, etc.); (2) local matching—identifying salient code spans that implement similar functionality; (3) optimal alignment computation—ranking candidates and generating explanations via optimal concept-to-code-span alignment. Concept alignment is integrated into both training and retrieval, encouraging the model to cover multiple functional aspects rather than relying on global similarity alone. Implemented by fine-tuning GraphCodeBERT (≈125M parameters).
summary_en.experiments: Compared against 6 encoder-only baselines (CodeBERT, UniXCoder, GraphCodeBERT, CoCoSoDa, HedgeCode, RAPID) and 2 decoder-only baselines (Qwen2.5-Coder-7B, CodeLlama-7B). Key result: on out-of-distribution benchmarks, baseline performance drops to near-random (MRR as low as 0.02), while XSearch boosts MRR to 0.33. A user study shows concept-alignment explanations enable participants to accept/reject results 38% faster and 10.5% more accurately than similarity scores alone.
summary_en.reading_guide: Recommended for skimming. Focus on the induction vs deduction paradigm analysis in the Introduction (pages 3-4) and the OoD generalization comparison in experiments (Tables 2-3). The concept decomposition and alignment algorithm details can be browsed quickly. Estimated reading time: ~30 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Author and affiliation information not provided.

recommendation.zh: 别把它当“更强检索器”，而是看它怎么把检索监督从全局相似度改成可验证的概念证据；重点读对齐定义与OOD设置是否干净。
recommendation.en: Don’t read it as “a stronger retriever”; read it for how it replaces global similarity supervision with verifiable concept-level evidence—only if the OOD protocol is clean.

paper.title: RecMem: Recurrence-based Memory Consolidation for Efficient and Effective Long-Running LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Memory systems often organize user-agent interactions as retrievable external memory and are crucial for long-running agents by overcoming the limited context windows of LLMs. However, existing memory systems invoke LLMs to process every incoming interaction for memory extraction, and such an eager memory consolidation scheme leads to substantial token consumption. To tackle this problem, we propose RecMem by rethinking when memory consolidation should be conducted. RecMem stores incoming intera

summary.core_problem: 长时运行的 LLM agent 需要外部记忆来突破上下文窗口，但现有记忆系统普遍对每次交互都做“急切式”LLM 记忆抽取与合并，导致构建阶段 token 成本过高。论文要解决的是：在不显著损失可用性的前提下，如何决定“什么时候值得调用 LLM 做记忆巩固”。
summary.importance:
更偏 agent 系统与成本工程，不是预训练方法论文。对基座研究的启发主要在两点：
1) 把“记忆写入”视为稀缺资源，采用事件触发（recurrence）而非逐步写入，类似把训练信号做门控；这类门控思想在持续学习/在线学习里也常见。
2) 反映了一个现实约束：很多 agent 方案的 token 成本主要消耗在“写记忆”而非“用记忆”，这会影响后续用交互轨迹做 continual pretrain / RL 数据闭环时的采样与记录策略。
summary.technical_approach:
RecMem 提出三层记忆架构与“基于复现的巩固”策略：
- Subconscious memory：对每条原始交互只做轻量 embedding 编码与存储，用于低成本检索与聚类，不调用 LLM。
- Consolidation trigger：当新交互在 subconscious 层检索到足够多语义相近/相关的历史交互（形成语义簇、出现持续复现）时，才调用 LLM 对该簇做记忆巩固，抽取 episodic memory（事件级摘要）与 semantic memory（更稳定的事实）。
- Semantic refinement：针对 episodic 摘要可能遗漏细粒度但对问答关键的信息，回看与该 episodic 关联的原始交互，补抽“持久且缺失”的事实并蒸馏为 semantic memory，降低信息损失。
整体上用“先廉价缓存 + 复现触发写入 + 写入后再精炼”替代“每步都写入”。
summary.experiments:
评测在两个长程记忆 benchmark：LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval-S；对比 Mem0、A-Mem、MemoryOS 等记忆系统。结论是：RecMem 在两套数据上问答准确率高于对比方法，同时显著降低记忆构建 token 成本。
- 在 LoCoMo 上，构建阶段 token 消耗最高可比基线降低 7.8×（论文图 1(d)）。
- 查询阶段 token 成本与现有系统相近，因此长交互历史下端到端成本更低。
（当前给出的全文片段未包含更细的分项数值与消融表；若论文后文提供触发阈值、簇大小、refinement 开关等消融，建议结合阅读以判断收益来自“少调用 LLM”还是“refinement 提升质量”。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读即可，预计 20-30 分钟：
- 先看 Figure 1（尤其 token cost 对比）把握动机与收益量级。
- 重点看 consolidation trigger 的判定规则（相似度度量、阈值、簇维护方式）以及 semantic refinement 的具体抽取提示与合并策略，这两处决定了系统是否稳健。
- 如果关心可迁移性：留意在不同 benchmark/不同交互分布下触发频率如何变化，以及是否会对“长尾但重要的一次性信息”造成漏记。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-running LLM agents rely on external memory to overcome limited context windows, but most existing systems perform eager LLM-based consolidation on every interaction, incurring large token costs. The paper asks when consolidation should happen, aiming to cut construction-time cost without sacrificing downstream QA usefulness.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an agent-memory systems paper rather than pretraining research. The transferable insight for foundation-model work is the gating principle: treat memory writing (and, by analogy, expensive supervision/processing) as a scarce resource and trigger it only under recurrence. It also highlights a practical bottleneck for continual-data loops: in many deployments, token spend is dominated by memory construction, which affects what interaction traces are feasible to log, distill, or reuse for continual pretraining/RL.
summary_en.technical_approach:
RecMem introduces recurrence-based consolidation with a three-tier design:
- A “subconscious” layer stores raw interactions encoded by lightweight embedding models for cheap retrieval, avoiding LLM calls.
- Consolidation is triggered only when an incoming interaction finds enough semantically similar/related past interactions (forming a meaningful cluster). Then an LLM extracts episodic memories (event-level summaries) and semantic memories (more stable facts) from the cluster.
- A semantic refinement step revisits the raw interactions linked to each episodic memory to recover fine-grained but query-critical details that episodic summarization may omit, distilling them into semantic memory to reduce lossy compression.
Overall, it replaces per-turn eager extraction with “cheap buffering + recurrence-triggered write + post-write refinement.”
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S, compared against Mem0, A-Mem, and MemoryOS. RecMem reports higher QA accuracy on both benchmarks while substantially reducing memory construction token cost.
- On LoCoMo, construction-time token consumption is reduced by up to 7.8× (as referenced around Fig. 1(d)).
- Query-time token cost remains comparable to baselines, so savings translate to lower end-to-end cost over long histories.
(The provided full-text excerpt does not include detailed ablations; if the paper contains them, the key is to separate gains from reduced consolidation frequency vs. refinement quality improvements.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim-level read, ~20–30 minutes.
- Start with the cost breakdown figure(s) to understand where savings come from.
- Focus on the consolidation trigger mechanics (similarity metric, thresholds, cluster maintenance) and the semantic refinement procedure (what is extracted, how it is merged).
- Check robustness discussions: how often consolidation triggers under different interaction distributions, and whether one-off but important facts risk being missed.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“记忆提炼触发条件”从每步调用改成 recurrence 触发，系统味道很对；只看方法和成本曲线，别把任务收益当成普适结论。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the shift from eager memory extraction to recurrence-triggered consolidation is a clean systems idea; read the method and cost curves, not the task gains as universal truth.

paper.title: Argus: Evidence Assembly for Scalable Deep Research Agents
paper.abstract: Deep research agents have achieved remarkable progress on complex information seeking tasks. Even long ReAct style rollouts explore only a single trajectory, while recent state of the art systems scale inference time compute via parallel search and aggregation. Yet deep research answers are composed of complementary pieces of evidence, which parallel rollouts often duplicate rather than complete, yielding diminishing returns while pushing the aggregation context toward the model's limit. We prop

summary.core_problem: Argus 解决的是 deep research agent 在扩大推理时计算时的冗余问题：并行 ReAct rollout 往往重复检索相同证据，最终聚合器又必须读入大量原始轨迹，导致信息增益很快饱和，并受限于上下文窗口。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 agentic inference 的结构化扩展有参考意义。它把“多条轨迹聚合”改成“证据图装配”，重点不再是采样更多答案，而是维护一个可更新、可审计、可压缩的中间状态。对基座研究员的启发主要在两点：一是复杂推理任务的瓶颈不只在模型能力，也在推理状态的表示；二是强化学习训练 agent 时，训练目标可以作用在中间结构的质量，而不只是最终答案。
summary.technical_approach: 系统由 Searcher 和 Navigator 两个角色组成。Searcher 是无状态 ReAct agent，接收一个查询，执行 search、visit、answer 等工具调用，返回完整轨迹。Navigator 负责改写初始问题、调度 Searcher、解析轨迹，并把证据和暂定 claim 写入一个有向无环图。图中的节点表示 evidence 或 claim，边表示 support 或 contradiction。这样，系统可以显式识别三类缺口：支撑不足的 claim、尚未解决的矛盾、问题中还没有被覆盖的方面。Navigator 随后为这些缺口生成更定向的 follow-up query，而不是重新跑完整任务。最终回答阶段，Navigator 清空构图过程中的工作上下文，只基于原问题和证据图生成答案。这个设计和普通 self-consistency、best-of-N、LLM synthesis 的区别在于：后者先生成多条完整轨迹，再在末端做选择或压缩；Argus 在推理过程中持续维护共享状态，让后续搜索围绕缺失证据展开。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 Argus 在 8 个 deep research benchmark 中有 5 个取得最好结果。系统使用 35B-A3B MoE backbone，同时作为 Searcher 和 Navigator。相对 raw Searcher，单 Searcher 设置平均提升 5.5 分；8 个并行 Searcher 设置平均提升 12.7 分。扩展到 64 个 Searcher 时，Argus 在 BrowseComp 上达到 86.2%。一个关键工程结果是压缩比：累计 Searcher 输出为 25.6M tokens，但通过证据图呈现给 Navigator 的视图只有 21.5K tokens，约为 1200:1。这说明收益主要来自状态表示和调度方式，而不是简单增加聚合上下文。由于给定内容没有展示完整消融表，仍需在全文中确认强化学习训练 Navigator 的具体奖励设计、图构建质量指标、预算控制策略，以及不同 Searcher 数量下的边际收益曲线。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议约 25–35 分钟。优先看系统方法部分，尤其是 evidence graph 的节点/边定义、Navigator 的 gap detection 规则、follow-up query 生成方式，以及最终答案如何只依赖图而不是原始轨迹。实验部分重点看三类图表：Searcher 数量扩展曲线、和 best-of-N/aggregation baselines 的比较、graph compression 与准确率的关系。若关心 RL agent 训练，建议细读 Navigator 的训练目标和奖励构造；这部分决定 Argus 是一个可学习的证据装配器，还是主要依赖 prompt 和规则的 orchestration 系统。

summary_en.core_problem: Argus targets a scaling bottleneck in deep research agents. Parallel ReAct rollouts often retrieve overlapping evidence, while the final aggregator has to consume long raw transcripts. More compute then adds redundant context rather than complementary information.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant for understanding how inference-time computation can be structured. Its main contribution is to replace flat trajectory aggregation with an explicit evidence state. For foundation-model research, the useful lesson is that complex reasoning systems may be limited by the representation of intermediate search state, not only by model size or sampling budget. It also suggests a cleaner interface for RL-trained agents: the training signal can target the quality of intermediate evidence assembly, not just final-answer accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Argus uses two cooperating agents. The Searcher is a stateless ReAct-style agent that receives a query, performs tool calls such as search and visit, and returns a full trajectory. The Navigator rewrites the original question, dispatches Searchers, parses returned traces, and incrementally builds a directed acyclic evidence graph. Nodes correspond to evidence pieces and tentative claims; edges encode support and contradiction. After each round, the Navigator inspects the graph for under-supported claims, unresolved contradictions, and uncovered aspects of the question. It then issues targeted follow-up queries instead of rerunning the entire task. At answer time, the Navigator drops the working context and reasons only over the question and the assembled graph. This differs from self-consistency, best-of-N, and LLM-based synthesis, which generate complete trajectories first and only aggregate at the end.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports best results on five of eight deep research benchmarks. Both Searcher and Navigator use a 35B-A3B MoE backbone. Compared with the raw Searcher, Argus improves average accuracy by 5.5 points with one Searcher and by 12.7 points with eight parallel Searchers. With 64 Searchers, it reaches 86.2% on BrowseComp. The most informative system result is compression: 25.6M tokens of accumulated Searcher output are routed through the graph and exposed to the Navigator as a 21.5K-token view, about a 1200:1 reduction. This supports the claim that the gain comes from structured state and targeted dispatch, rather than simply giving the aggregator more transcripts. The provided excerpt does not include the full ablation details, so the reward design for Navigator training, graph-quality metrics, and compute-budget curves should be checked in the full experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim should take about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the method section: the evidence-graph schema, the Navigator’s gap-detection procedure, follow-up query generation, and the final synthesis step that uses only the graph. In the experiments, look for scaling curves over the number of Searchers, comparisons against best-of-N and learned aggregation baselines, and the relation between graph compression and answer accuracy. If interested in RL for agents, read the Navigator training section carefully; it determines whether Argus is mainly a learned evidence assembler or mostly a prompted orchestration pipeline.

recommendation.zh: 把“扩展test-time compute”从并行采样改成证据图装配是对的方向；只看evidence graph调度与去重策略，评测是否公平要打问号。
recommendation.en: The shift from parallel sampling to evidence-graph assembly is the right idea for scaling test-time compute; focus on the graph scheduling/dedup logic, but scrutinize evaluation cleanliness.

paper.title: DimMem: Dimensional Structuring for Efficient Long-Term Agent Memory
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents require long-term memory to leverage information from past interactions. However, existing memory systems often face a fidelity--efficiency trade-off: raw dialogue histories are expensive, while flat facts or summaries may discard the structure needed for precise recall. We propose \textbf{DimMem}, a lightweight dimensional memory framework that represents each memory as an atomic, typed, and self-contained unit with explicit fields such as time, location, reaso

summary.core_problem: 解决 agent 长期记忆系统在保真度与效率之间的矛盾：原始对话历史太贵，扁平事实或摘要又丢失精确召回所需结构。
summary.importance: 这是轻量级 agent memory 设计工作。贡献在于提出结构化、维度化的记忆单元表示，并展示它能在较低 token 成本下维持较好召回。对预训练研究员的直接启发有限，但对外部记忆表示设计有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DimMem，把每条记忆表示为原子化、带类型、字段自包含的单元，显式包含时间、地点、原因、目的、关键词等维度。基于这些字段做 dimension-aware retrieval、记忆更新和选择性上下文回填。方法本质上是把自由文本记忆压成结构化 schema，以换取检索效率和更可控的召回。
summary.experiments: 在 LoCoMo-10 和 LongMemEval-S 上分别达到 81.43% 和 78.20% 总体准确率，并在 LoCoMo 上把单次查询 token 成本降低 24%。摘要还提到维度化记忆抽取具有一定鲁棒性。需要进一步看与哪些 lightweight memory baselines 比、是否牺牲开放式生成质量，以及 schema 抽取错误如何传播到后续检索。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自厦门大学、上海科技大学。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the fidelity-efficiency trade-off in long-term memory for LLM agents: raw dialogue history is expensive, while flat facts or summaries often lose the structure needed for precise recall.
summary_en.importance: This is a lightweight agent-memory design paper. Its contribution is a structured, dimensional memory unit that improves retrieval efficiency while preserving useful recall structure. The direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but it is a reasonable reference for external memory representation design.
summary_en.technical_approach: DimMem represents each memory as an atomic, typed, self-contained unit with explicit fields such as time, location, reason, purpose, and keywords. These fields support dimension-aware retrieval, memory updates, and selective context reinjection. Conceptually, it compresses free-form memory into a structured schema to gain efficiency and controllability.
summary_en.experiments: On LoCoMo-10 and LongMemEval-S, it reports 81.43% and 78.20% overall accuracy, respectively, while reducing per-query token cost on LoCoMo by 24%. The abstract also claims robust dimensional memory extraction. The main things to verify are the strength of lightweight baselines, whether open-ended generation quality degrades, and how extraction errors propagate into retrieval failures.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Xiamen University and ShanghaiTech University.

recommendation.zh: 是外部记忆 schema 设计，不是基座方法；看结果表确认结构化字段是否真优于摘要记忆，正文可不读。
recommendation.en: This is external-memory schema design, not a base-model paper; just check whether structured fields really beat summary memory in the main table and skip the rest.

paper.title: Think When Needed: Adaptive Reasoning-Driven Multimodal Embeddings with a Dual-LoRA Architecture
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have emerged as a powerful backbone for multimodal embeddings. Recent methods introduce chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning into the embedding pipeline to improve retrieval quality, but remain costly in both model size and inference cost. They typically employ separate reasoner and embedder with substantial parameter overhead, and generate CoT indiscriminately for every input. However, we observe that for simple inputs, discriminative embeddings already perf

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态 embedding 检索中 CoT 推理成本高、且对简单样本可能产生负迁移的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态检索/embedding 系统的效率和训练设计改进，不是基座预训练方法。对预训练研究员的价值在于观察到“推理并非总是改善表示”，这对把 reasoning trace 接入表示学习有一定提醒。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Think When Needed：在一个冻结的多模态骨干上挂载 reasoning LoRA 和 embedding LoRA 两个适配器，用 dual-LoRA 共享主体参数；在 reasoning 与 embedding 接口处做梯度截断，降低联合优化的梯度冲突；同时根据输入难度自适应决定是否生成推理过程，而不是对所有样本无差别引入 CoT。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整模型规模、训练数据和具体 benchmark 数字。已知实验目标是多模态检索质量与推理成本，比较对象应包括无推理 embedding、固定 CoT 推理 embedding、以及分离 reasoner/embedder 的方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the cost and potential negative transfer of using chain-of-thought reasoning for every input in multimodal embedding and retrieval.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an efficiency and training-design improvement for multimodal retrieval embeddings, not a foundation-model pretraining result. Its useful signal for pretraining researchers is the claim that explicit reasoning can harm representation quality on easy inputs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Think When Needed uses a frozen multimodal backbone with two LoRA adapters, one for reasoning and one for embedding. It detaches gradients at the interface to reduce conflicts under joint optimization, and it adaptively decides whether an input needs reasoning instead of always generating CoT.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not report model size, training data, benchmarks, or exact gains. The intended comparisons are against non-reasoning embeddings, always-on CoT embedding pipelines, and separate reasoner-embedder systems.

recommendation.zh: 作为“reasoning trace 可能污染表示”的弱证据即可，不必读正文；若做多模态 embedding，可看方法图。
recommendation.en: Treat it as weak evidence that reasoning traces can pollute embeddings; no need to read beyond the method figure unless working on multimodal retrieval.

paper.title: Context Training with Active Information Seeking
paper.abstract: Most existing large language models (LLMs) are expensive to adapt after deployment, especially when a task requires newly produced information or niche domain knowledge. Recent work has shown that, by manipulating and optimizing their context, LLMs can be tailored to downstream tasks without updating their weights. However, most existing methods remain closed-loop, relying solely on the model's intrinsic knowledge. In this paper, we equip these context optimizers with Wikipedia search and browse

summary.core_problem: 解决部署后不更新权重的 LLM 如何通过优化上下文并主动检索外部信息来适配新任务和长尾知识的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是上下文优化与工具使用方法。它对 pretrain 的直接价值有限，但能提供一个信号：模型能力越来越依赖上下文构造、检索策略和候选上下文搜索，而不是单次 prompt engineering。
summary.technical_approach: 在已有 context optimizer 上加入 Wikipedia search 与 browser tools，并指出简单串行地把工具接入上下文优化会降低性能。论文改用 search-based training，维护多个候选上下文，在搜索过程中剪枝，避免单一路径早期错误污染最终上下文。
summary.experiments: 覆盖低资源翻译 Flores+、健康场景等多领域任务。摘要称主动信息获取与多候选上下文搜索结合后有一致且显著收益，但未给出模型规模、具体 LLM、检索预算、baseline 名称和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 给定机构为 The University of Edinburgh；Arthur Szlam 和 Marc'Aurelio Ranzato 是大模型与强化学习/序列建模领域知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how deployed LLMs can adapt to new tasks and niche or newly produced knowledge by optimizing context and actively seeking external information, without updating model weights.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a method for context optimization with tool use. Its direct pretraining value is limited, but it gives a useful signal: downstream competence can depend heavily on context search, retrieval policy, and candidate management rather than one-shot prompt design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work augments context optimizers with Wikipedia search and browser tools. It finds that naively inserting tools into a standard sequential context optimization pipeline can hurt performance. The proposed alternative uses search-based training, keeps multiple candidate contexts, and prunes them to reduce early-path error lock-in.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans low-resource translation on Flores+, health scenarios, and other domains. The abstract reports consistent and substantial gains from active information seeking when paired with multi-candidate context search, but does not provide model sizes, exact LLMs, retrieval budgets, baseline names, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is The University of Edinburgh; Arthur Szlam and Marc'Aurelio Ranzato are well-known researchers in large-scale learning, reinforcement learning, and sequence modeling.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文；看 abstract 和算法图即可，关键点是“加工具会变差，搜索式上下文训练才稳”。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; the useful bit is that adding tools can hurt unless context optimization is treated as search with pruning.

paper.title: Context-Gated Associative Retrieval: From Theory to Transformers
paper.abstract: Hopfield networks and their generalizations have established deep connections among biological associative memories, statistical physics, and transformers. Yet most models treat retrieval as a fixed query-to-memory mapping, ignoring the role of external context in recall. In this work, we propose a two-stage associative memory architecture, wherein a context-gate subcircuit reshapes the retrieval energy landscape before and during recall. We show theoretically that context gating increases inter

summary.core_problem: 现有联想记忆模型及Transformer注意力与联想记忆的等价性研究，均将检索视为固定的查询-记忆映射，未解释外部上下文如何调控记忆检索过程，也无法对应LLM中系统提示、上下文示例改变查询输出的现象，以及ICL、事实召回中观察到的「任务确定-检索执行」两阶段机制。
summary.importance: 为解释LLM的上下文调控检索、ICL的内在机制提供了能量视角的理论框架，其两阶段架构设计和上下文门控的理论结论，可启发Transformer注意力模块的改进和预训练目标的优化。
summary.technical_approach: 在模块化Hopfield能量框架下提出两阶段联想记忆架构：1）新增上下文门控层，每个存储的记忆对应一个门控神经元，通过双线性能量项实现上下文对门控的激活，再引入基于记忆相似度的正能自连接项，天然诱导门控的稀疏性（相似记忆对应的门控相互抑制）；2）门控层与检索层通过耦合能量项连接，检索层采用LogSumExp拉格朗日量输出记忆分布；3）理论证明上下文门控可提升记忆间的有效分离度，带来检索能力的指数级提升，且耦合系统存在唯一自洽不动点，检索结果同时受上下文的直接偏置和门控-检索的非线性反馈共同驱动；4）将模型一阶近似映射到Transformer内部机制，验证LLM原生动态符合该理论。
summary.experiments: 理论层面推导了门控层的稀疏性相变、记忆分离度的定量提升、耦合系统不动点的唯一性；实证层面在Llama-3-8B上验证了ICL和事实召回过程中，LLM的动态与提出的框架一致：上下文先定位任务相关的记忆子空间，再让查询在该缩小集合内完成检索区分。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第2节理论部分的架构设计和核心证明，第3节与Transformer机制的映射部分；附录A的模块化能量框架基础可按需查阅。预计阅读时间30-40分钟，重点关注门控自连接项的构造和不动点证明的逻辑，以及如何对应到LLM的实际行为。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing associative memory models and the equivalence between Transformer attention and associative memory treat retrieval as a fixed query-to-memory mapping. They neither explain how external context modulates memory retrieval, nor account for phenomena in LLMs where system prompts or in-context examples alter query outputs, nor align with the two-phase 'task determination - retrieval execution' mechanism observed in ICL and factual recall.
summary_en.importance: It provides an energy-based theoretical framework for explaining context-modulated retrieval and intrinsic ICL mechanisms in LLMs. Its two-stage architecture design and theoretical conclusions on context gating can inform improvements to Transformer attention modules and pre-training objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: A two-stage associative memory architecture is proposed under the modular Hopfield energy framework: 1) A context gate layer is added, with one gate neuron per stored memory. Context activates gates via a bilinear energy term, and a positive-energy self-connection term based on inter-memory similarity inherently induces sparsity in gate activations (gates for similar memories suppress each other). 2) The gate layer and retrieval layer are connected via a coupling energy term, and the retrieval layer uses a LogSumExp Lagrangian to output a distribution over memories. 3) Theoretical proofs show context gating increases effective inter-memory separation, leading to exponential retrieval performance gains, and the coupled system has a unique self-consistent fixed point, meaning retrieval results are driven by both direct contextual bias and non-linear gate-retrieval feedback. 4) A first-order approximation of the model is mapped to internal Transformer mechanisms to verify that native LLM dynamics align with the theory.
summary_en.experiments: Theoretically, it derives the sparsity phase transition of the gate layer, quantitative improvement in memory separation, and uniqueness of the coupled system's fixed point. Empirically, it verifies on Llama-3-8B that during ICL and factual recall, LLM dynamics align with the proposed framework: context first locates the task-relevant memory subspace, then allows the query to perform retrieval discrimination within this narrowed set.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for architecture design and core theoretical proofs, and Section 3 for the mapping to Transformer mechanisms. Appendix A on the modular energy framework can be consulted as needed. Estimated reading time: 30-40 minutes. Pay attention to the construction of the gate self-connection term, the logic of the fixed point proof, and how these correspond to actual LLM behaviors.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 ICL 到底像不像检索，这篇值得看定理和 Llama-3 对应式；但先别把“ICL=门控检索”当定论，经验支撑还偏薄。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care whether ICL is really retrieval-like; focus on the theorem and the Llama-3 mapping, but treat the “ICL = gated retrieval” claim as suggestive, not settled.

paper.title: DiffRetriever: Parallel Representative Tokens for Retrieval with Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: PromptReps showed that an autoregressive language model can be used directly as a retriever by prompting it to generate dense and sparse representations of a query or passage. Extending this to multiple representatives is inefficient for autoregressive models, since tokens must be generated sequentially, and prior multi-token variants did not reliably improve over single-token decoding.   We show that the bottleneck is sequential generation, not the multi-token idea itself. DiffRetriever is a re

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“检索能不能用 LLM 做”，而是一个更具体也更关键的问题：把语言模型当 retriever 时，单个代表 token 往往过于压缩，多 token 表示理论上更接近 late-interaction 检索器，但在自回归模型里，多 token 需要逐步生成，编码延迟随 token 数线性增长，而且先前工作里效果也不稳定。作者想验证，瓶颈到底是“多 token 表示本身没用”，还是“AR 顺序生成把这个想法做坏了”。他们给出的答案是后者：如果换成 diffusion LM，用并行 masked-position prediction 一次性读出 K 个代表位置，多 token 检索就能稳定带来收益。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它给 diffusion LM 提供了一个很贴近预训练目标的下游用法：不是把 diffusion backbone 当普通 encoder 做 mean pooling，而是直接利用其“并行填 mask”的原生接口来产出检索表示。这一点很重要，因为很多 diffusion LM 工作在评测时会退化成 BERT 式编码器，难以回答这种建模范式本身到底带来了什么。第二，这篇工作把“并行生成多个表示位点”这个能力和检索效果、延迟特性直接连起来，说明 diffusion/非 AR 范式的价值不只在生成，也可能体现在表示学习和 serving 形态上。贡献量级不在于提出全新检索框架，而在于把 diffusion LM 的训练-推理一致性优势落到一个可测、可复现、且和 AR 有清晰对照的任务上。
summary.technical_approach:
方法延续 PromptReps 的基本思路：通过提示词让模型“用几个词表示 query 或 passage”，然后从回答位置抽取 hidden states 作为 dense representation、抽取 logits 作为 sparse representation，再用这些表示去做检索打分。真正的改动集中在表示的产生方式。

对于 AR backbone，代表 token 是在 assistant 前缀后按从左到右生成的，生成多少个 token 就要跑多少步前向，成本随 token 数增加。对于 diffusion backbone，作者把 prompt 改写成固定长度，在末尾追加 K 个 [MASK] 位置和闭合 token，让模型在双向注意力下同时预测这 K 个位置。这样每个 mask 位都能看到完整前缀、其他 mask 位以及结束符，K 个位置的 hidden state 和 logits 可以在一次前向里同时读出。

这里有两个设计点值得注意。第一，作者强调自己是在“按模型预训练时的方式使用 diffusion LM”。这和 DiffEmbed、pplx-embed 这类把 diffusion 模型当 encoder 做池化的路线不同，后者没有真正利用 masked-position prediction 这个训练目标。第二，query 和 passage 的预算 Kq、Kp 需要预先固定，因为 diffusion 序列长度要先定下来；AR 则是变长生成。这个差异带来一个很实际的问题：固定预算是否浪费容量。作者后面专门分析了 deployable budget 和 oracle budget 的差距。

训练方面，除了 zero-shot 提示检索，作者还加了 contrastive fine-tuning，使 DiffRetriever 既能比较“原生提示式检索”，也能比较“训练后 retriever”。从论文描述看，整体 scoring pipeline 仍然尽量贴近 PromptReps，因此实验里的差异主要来自表示生成范式，而不是后端打分器被大改。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖两类 backbone：AR 用 LLaMA3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B；diffusion 用 LLaDA-8B、Dream-7B。评测集包括 MS MARCO、TREC DL 2019/2020，以及 BEIR-7 这七个跨域数据集；同时看 zero-shot 和 supervised fine-tuning 两种设置。

结论很清楚。第一，多 token 对 diffusion backbone 是稳定增益，对 AR backbone 则不是。作者报告 multi-token DiffRetriever 在所有测试的 diffusion backbone 上都显著优于 single-token，而 AR 版本的 multi-token 没有稳定超过 single-token。也就是说，先前 PromptReps 多 token 不稳定，不足以否定“多代表位点”这个方向，更可能是被顺序生成的代价和噪声掩盖了。

第二，延迟收益来自并行解码，而不是 FLOPs 数量级变化。文中明确说明，从渐近 FLOPs 看，带 KV cache 的 AR 和 diffusion 都可随 K 线性增长；真正的差别在 wall-clock latency：AR 必须串行跑多次前向，diffusion 一次并行完成。Figure 1 是理解整篇文章最关键的图之一，因为它把“效果提升”和“延迟近似不变”放在同一个坐标系里。

第三，DiffRetriever 的优势在 zero-shot 和 fine-tuned 两种场景都能保留。作者指出，zero-shot 时基于 LLaDA 的 DiffRetriever 是对比系统里最强的；在 fine-tuning 后，基于 Dream 的 DiffRetriever 成为 BEIR-7 上整体最强的 retriever，超过 fine-tuned PromptReps、DiffEmbed 和 RepLLaMA。摘要里没有给出完整表格数字，但从正文结论看，这不是个别数据集上的偶然提升，而是跨 in-domain / out-of-domain 的一致趋势。

第四，预算选择是一个被低估的问题。作者做了一个“完美 per-query budget predictor”的 oracle 分析，发现如果能在冻结基座模型上按 query 自适应选择预算，在相同固定平均预算下，oracle 甚至能超过 contrastive fine-tuning 的固定预算方案，而且这一点在所有 backbone-benchmark 组合上都成立。这说明当前固定 Kq/Kp 的部署方式留下了明显性能空间，也提示未来可以把预算预测当成 retrieval-time policy 问题来做。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读但要抓住几个关键位置。

先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1。这里基本把论文最重要的判断讲清楚了：多 token 想法本身成立，问题出在 AR 的顺序生成。Figure 1 同时展示效果和延迟，是整篇最值得先看的图。

然后看 Method 里的 §3.2 和 §3.3。重点不是 prompt 文案，而是两种 backbone 在“同样读 hidden state + logits”的前提下，只改变表示产生方式。要特别注意作者如何把 diffusion 的 K 个 [MASK] 位置接到 chat template 后面，以及为什么 closing tokens 也放进可见上下文。

实验部分优先看 zero-shot 与 fine-tuned 的主表，再看预算分析对应的小节。阅读时建议带着两个问题：一是 gains 是否主要来自多 token，还是来自 diffusion backbone 本身；二是固定预算是否已经接近最优。附录里关于 prompt wording（“a few words” 优于固定“三个词”）和 memory 限制下 AR fine-tuning token cap 的说明，可以快速扫一遍，帮助判断实验是否公平。

如果时间有限，30 分钟内可以读完主线：Introduction、方法图、主结果表、预算 oracle 分析。若想深挖，则重点看作者如何界定 latency 与 FLOPs 的区别，以及为什么把训练对齐的 retrieval-time objective 视为 DiffEmbed 类方法之外的另一条路线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise question: when using a language model directly as a retriever, is the failure of multi-token representative retrieval due to the idea itself, or due to autoregressive sequential decoding? Single-token PromptReps is efficient but heavily compressive. Multi-token representations should be closer to late-interaction retrieval, yet prior AR implementations were slow and did not consistently beat the single-token setup. DiffRetriever isolates this issue by moving to diffusion language models, where K representative positions can be predicted in parallel rather than generated one by one.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining research is that it evaluates diffusion LMs in a way that is aligned with their native training objective. Instead of turning a diffusion LM into a generic encoder with mean pooling, it uses masked-position prediction at retrieval time and reads out representations from those masked slots. That makes the comparison more meaningful: the gain is tied to the modeling paradigm, not just to backbone scale. The paper also shows a concrete systems-level implication of non-AR modeling: parallel multi-position representation extraction can improve retrieval quality without the sequential latency penalty of AR decoding. This is not a new retrieval paradigm by itself, but it is a clean demonstration of where diffusion-style pretraining can matter beyond text generation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The overall recipe follows PromptReps. A query or passage is prompted in natural language, and the model is asked to represent it with a few words. From the model response, hidden states are used as dense representations and token logits as sparse representations; retrieval scoring is then performed against indexed passage representations.

The key change is how those representative tokens are produced. In the AR setting, representative tokens are generated left-to-right after the assistant prefix, so producing K tokens requires K sequential decoding steps. In the diffusion setting, the prompt is extended with K [MASK] positions plus closing tokens, and the model predicts all masked positions jointly under bidirectional attention. The hidden states and logits at those K positions are read out in a single forward pass.

Two design choices matter. First, the authors explicitly frame this as training-aligned usage of a diffusion LM. This differs from encoder-style baselines such as DiffEmbed and pplx-embed, which use the diffusion backbone more like BERT and do not exploit the masked prediction interface at inference time. Second, diffusion requires fixed sequence length, so query and passage budgets (Kq and Kp) must be chosen in advance, unlike variable-length AR decoding. The paper later shows that this fixed-budget choice leaves measurable headroom, motivating adaptive per-query budget selection.

The paper also adds a contrastive fine-tuning stage on top of the zero-shot prompted retriever. This is useful because it keeps the retrieval pipeline close to PromptReps while allowing a comparison between prompted retrieval and trained retrieval under the same representation-generation principle.
summary_en.experiments:
The study compares two AR backbones, LLaMA3-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, against two diffusion backbones, LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B. Evaluation covers MS MARCO, TREC DL 2019/2020, and BEIR-7, in both zero-shot and supervised fine-tuning settings.

The central empirical result is consistent: multi-token retrieval helps diffusion backbones and does not reliably help AR backbones. Multi-token DiffRetriever improves over the single-token variant on every tested diffusion model, while AR multi-token decoding shows no stable gain over the single-token baseline. This directly supports the paper’s thesis that the bottleneck is sequential generation rather than the multi-token retrieval idea itself.

The latency story is also important. The authors note that diffusion does not have an asymptotic FLOPs advantage over AR with KV caching; both scale linearly with K. The practical advantage is wall-clock latency: AR requires multiple sequential forward passes, whereas diffusion finishes in one parallel pass. Figure 1 is therefore central because it ties quality gains to nearly constant latency as K grows.

The gains transfer across settings. In zero-shot evaluation, DiffRetriever on LLaDA is reported as the strongest system among the compared methods, ahead of PromptReps on AR backbones and ahead of the encoder-style DiffEmbed baseline. After supervised fine-tuning, DiffRetriever on Dream becomes the strongest overall retriever on BEIR-7, outperforming fine-tuned PromptReps, DiffEmbed, and RepLLaMA. The paper text emphasizes that this is not a one-dataset anomaly but a repeated pattern across in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks.

A particularly useful analysis concerns budget selection. With a perfect per-query budget predictor on the frozen base model, the oracle adaptive-budget setup exceeds contrastive fine-tuning under the same fixed average budget on every backbone-benchmark pair tested. This suggests that fixed Kq/Kp deployment leaves substantial effectiveness on the table and that adaptive retrieval-time budgeting is a serious follow-up direction.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction and Figure 1. They contain the main claim of the paper in its cleanest form: multi-token retrieval is viable, but AR sequential decoding obscures its value. Figure 1 is the fastest way to understand both the effectiveness and latency argument.

Then read Section 3.2 carefully. The important point is not the prompt wording but the fact that both AR and diffusion variants read out the same kinds of signals—hidden states and logits—while differing only in how representative positions are produced. Pay attention to how the K masked slots are appended to the chat template and why the closing tokens are included in the visible context.

In the experiments, prioritize the main zero-shot and fine-tuned result tables, then the budget analysis section. Two questions are worth keeping in mind while reading: are the gains coming from diffusion as a backbone, or specifically from parallel multi-token extraction; and how suboptimal is a fixed representation budget? If time is limited, the mainline can be read in about 30 minutes: Introduction, method core, main tables, and the oracle budget analysis. The appendix on prompt wording and AR token caps is useful for checking fairness but not essential on a first pass.

recommendation.zh: 扩散LM在检索任务的落地尝试，仅查看§3方法部分和效果对比表即可
recommendation.en: Practical attempt of diffusion LM for retrieval tasks, only read §3 method section and performance comparison tables

institutions: The University of Queensland, Brisbane, QLD

paper.title: Rethinking Experience Utilization in Self-Evolving Language Model Agents
paper.abstract: Self-evolving agents improve by accumulating and reusing experience from past interactions. Existing work has largely focused on how experience is constructed, represented, and updated, while paying less attention to how experience should be used during runtime decision-making. As a result, most agents rely on rigid usage strategies, either injecting experience once at initialization or at every step, without considering whether it is needed for the current decision. This paper studies experienc

summary.core_problem: 解决自进化语言模型 agent 中，历史经验在运行时应如何被调用，而不是只研究经验如何构造与存储。
summary.importance: 贡献点在 agent runtime 策略而非基座模型；有一定方法论价值，因为它把“经验是否该在当前决策点介入”单独拿出来研究，但对预训练研究的直接启发较弱。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ExpWeaver，把经验作为推理过程中的可选资源，而不是固定在初始化时一次性注入，或在每一步机械注入。方法尽量不改经验构造模块，只改运行时使用策略，以测试经验调用与决策交织是否更优。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示在 4 个代表性框架、7 个任务上做了实验，但截断后未给出具体模型、数据集、baseline 和提升幅度。能确认的是作者试图做跨框架验证，而不是只在单一 agent 上报数。
summary.authors_note: 哈尔滨工业大学、华为。团队长期做 NLP、对话与智能体方向。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how past experience should be used at runtime in self-evolving LM agents, rather than only how experience should be built or stored.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly about agent runtime policy, not foundation-model training. The angle is still useful because it isolates experience utilization as a separate design axis.
summary_en.technical_approach: ExpWeaver exposes experience as an optional resource during reasoning, instead of injecting it only once at initialization or at every step. The paper keeps experience construction unchanged and modifies only runtime utilization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates evaluation across four representative frameworks and seven tasks, but the provided text is truncated and does not include concrete model sizes, datasets, baselines, or gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Harbin Institute of Technology and Huawei. The teams are active in NLP and agent-related research.

recommendation.zh: 点子是对的：经验使用策略常被低估；但它主要是 agent runtime 设计，不会直接改你对 pretrain 的判断，读方法图和主表就够。
recommendation.en: The premise is sensible—experience usage is under-studied—but this is mostly an agent runtime paper, not something that will directly move your pretraining priors; skim the method figure and main table.

paper.title: LatentRAG: Latent Reasoning and Retrieval for Efficient Agentic RAG
paper.abstract: Single-step retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) provides an efficient way to incorporate external information for simple question answering tasks but struggles with complex questions. Agentic RAG extends this paradigm by replacing single-step retrieval with a multi-step process, in which the large language model (LLM) acts as a search agent that generates intermediate thoughts and subqueries to iteratively interact with the retrieval system. This iterative process incurs substantial latency due

summary.core_problem: LatentRAG 解决的是 agentic RAG 的主要延迟来自显式思维链和子查询逐 token 生成的问题，并进一步尝试把“该检索什么”从自然语言子查询迁移到连续隐空间表示。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练研究的直接价值不在基座训练本身，而在 latent reasoning 与检索接口的结合。它把连续 latent token 从“只用于内部推理”推进到“可驱动外部检索”的位置。这个方向值得泛读，因为它触及两个更基础的问题：第一，模型能否用非文本中间表示完成可控的信息交互；第二，检索信号能否通过可微接口反向约束 LLM 的中间状态。对未来的 latent reasoning、工具调用、RAG 训练目标设计都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法的核心是用特殊 thought token 和 subquery token 替代显式自然语言思维和子查询。模型前向时，这些特殊 token 对应位置的最后一层 hidden state 被视为 latent thought 和 latent subquery。由于这些位置可以一次 prefill 得到，避免了多轮自回归生成长 thought 和长 query 的串行开销。

难点在于 latent subquery 不能直接作为传统检索器的文本输入。论文采用对齐策略：用预训练 dense retriever 处理自然语言子查询，得到其在文档集合上的相似度分布；再把 LLM 产生的 latent subquery 输入检索模块，得到 latent 查询对应的文档相似度分布；训练时最小化两者的 KL divergence。这样做的好处是，不需要大规模人工标注的中间 query-document 对，也不需要为每个中间子查询构造显式监督。

另一个设计点是可解释性。纯 latent 中间步骤会让 agentic RAG 的证据链变得不透明。论文引入并行的 latent semantic alignment，让 latent token 承载更接近自然语言中间步骤的语义。这个设计不是为了恢复完整 CoT，而是为了约束 latent 表示不要退化成难以控制的检索捷径。
summary.experiments:
论文在引言中给出的延迟分析很关键：代表性 agentic RAG 方法 Search-R1 在多跳问答数据集上的总推理时间约为 naive single-step RAG 的 16–22 倍；其中 thought generation 和 subquery generation 合计占总延迟约 90%。这说明瓶颈主要不是检索本身，也不是最终答案生成，而是中间自然语言轨迹的自回归生成。

由于提供的正文片段未包含完整实验表，具体数据集、最终准确率、延迟下降幅度、消融结果和模型规模无法可靠确认。可确认的实验逻辑包括：比较 naive RAG、显式 agentic RAG 与 LatentRAG 的端到端 QA 表现和延迟；验证 latent subquery 是否能保持检索质量；消融 KL 分布对齐、latent semantic alignment、联合优化等组件对准确率、检索召回和可解释性的影响。
summary.reading_guide:
建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看三部分：第一，看 Fig. 1 的延迟分解，判断问题设定是否成立；第二，看 latent subquery 与 dense retriever 的接口设计，尤其是 KL divergence 对齐的是文档相似度分布而不是单个正例文档；第三，看可解释性相关的 latent semantic alignment，以及它是否只是辅助 loss，还是会影响主检索路径。

如果只关心预训练方向，可以重点关注“连续中间状态如何承接外部工具/检索接口”这一点。它比普通 RAG 工程优化更接近建模范式问题。

summary_en.core_problem: LatentRAG targets the main latency bottleneck in agentic RAG: explicit autoregressive generation of intermediate thoughts and subqueries. It asks whether both reasoning and retrieval decisions can be moved from natural language tokens into continuous latent states.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it connects latent reasoning with an external retrieval interface. The main signal is that latent tokens are not only used as private computation states; they are trained to drive retrieval. This matters for future work on latent reasoning, tool use, and differentiable retrieval, where intermediate supervision may come from external systems rather than text trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method replaces explicit thoughts and subqueries with special thought and subquery tokens. The last hidden states at these token positions are treated as latent thoughts and latent subqueries. Since these states are produced in a single forward pass, the model avoids the sequential cost of generating long intermediate text.

The central technical issue is retrieval. A latent subquery cannot be directly fed into a standard text retriever. The paper aligns the LLM-generated latent subquery with a pretrained dense retriever in embedding space. A natural-language subquery induces a similarity distribution over documents through the retriever. The latent subquery induces another distribution. Training minimizes the KL divergence between these two distributions. This avoids requiring large-scale supervised query-document pairs for intermediate subqueries, which are usually unavailable in agentic RAG training setups.

The paper also addresses transparency. Pure latent reasoning hides intermediate decisions. To reduce this problem, it adds a parallel semantic alignment objective so that latent tokens retain meaningful semantics instead of becoming opaque retrieval triggers.
summary_en.experiments:
The most important reported observation in the provided text is the latency breakdown. On multi-hop QA datasets, a representative agentic RAG system, Search-R1, takes about 16–22× the inference time of naive single-step RAG. Thought generation and subquery generation together account for roughly 90% of total latency. This supports the paper’s claim that the bottleneck is not retrieval or final answer generation, but autoregressive generation of intermediate trajectories.

The supplied full-text excerpt does not include the complete experimental tables, so exact accuracy, latency reduction, model scale, dataset list, and ablation numbers cannot be verified. The expected key experiments are comparisons against naive RAG and explicit agentic RAG, retrieval-quality evaluation for latent subqueries, and ablations on KL distribution alignment, semantic alignment, and joint optimization.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim in 20–30 minutes. Start with the latency decomposition in Fig. 1 to check whether the motivation is quantitatively supported. Then read the latent retrieval section carefully, especially the choice to align document-similarity distributions rather than supervise individual retrieved documents. Finally, inspect the semantic-alignment component and the ablations, if available, to see whether the latent states remain controllable.

For pretraining-oriented readers, the useful part is the interface between continuous intermediate states and an external retrieval system. That is closer to a modeling question than to ordinary RAG engineering.

recommendation.zh: 读 latent-query 对齐和延迟表即可；思路有用，但若只在小 QA 集上赢，不能外推到通用 agent。
recommendation.en: Skim the latent-query alignment and latency tables; useful idea, but small-QA wins should not be extrapolated to general agents.

institutions: University of Amsterdam, Amsterdam, the Netherlands

paper.title: SkillRet: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Skill Retrieval in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: As LLM agents are increasingly deployed with large libraries of reusable skills, selecting the right skill for a user request has become a critical systems challenge. In small libraries, users may invoke skills explicitly by name, but this assumption breaks down as skill ecosystems grow under tight context and latency budgets. Despite its practical importance, skill retrieval remains underexplored, with limited benchmarks and little understanding of retrieval behavior on realistic skill librarie

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent生态中可复用技能库规模持续扩大，现有依赖显式命名或全量上下文加载的技能调用方式不再可行，技能检索成为规模化Agent系统的核心瓶颈，但该领域缺乏大规模、公开的专用评测基准，现有工作多关注端到端执行而非检索本身。
summary.importance: 填补了Agent技能检索领域的基准空白，为技能检索模型的训练、评测以及规模化Agent系统的检索层设计提供了标准化数据集和基线参考。
summary.technical_approach: 从公开Agent技能市场爬取22795条技能，经过质量过滤、去重、多轮校验得到17810条高质量可复用技能，构建包含63259条训练样本、4997条评测样本的数据集，标注二级分类标签（6大类18小类），支持技能检索任务的细粒度分析。
summary.experiments: 1. 现有通用检索模型在技能检索任务上表现有限，说明技能检索是独立于通用文本检索、工具检索的专门任务；2. 在SkillRet训练集上做任务特定微调可带来显著性能提升，小参数微调模型的表现可匹配甚至超过大参数通用检索模型；3. 重排序的收益取决于第一阶段检索的性能上限，当基础检索模型足够强时，重排序的边际收益快速下降；4. 微调模型的性能提升主要来自对长查询中少量与技能相关的关键句子的精准聚焦。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看基准构建流程、核心实验结论部分，预计阅读时间15分钟；如需构建相关检索系统可参考附录的数据集字段说明与基线实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: As reusable skill libraries for LLM agents grow continuously, existing skill invocation methods relying on explicit naming or full context loading become infeasible. Skill retrieval has become a core bottleneck for large-scale agent systems, but there is a lack of large-scale, public dedicated evaluation benchmarks in this field, and most existing work focuses on end-to-end execution rather than retrieval itself.
summary_en.importance: Fills the benchmark gap in agent skill retrieval. Provides a standardized dataset and baseline reference for training and evaluating skill retrieval models, as well as designing retrieval layers for large-scale agent systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Crawls 22,795 skills from public agent skill marketplaces, obtains 17,810 high-quality reusable skills through quality filtering, deduplication, and multi-round validation. Constructs a dataset with 63,259 training samples and 4,997 evaluation samples, annotated with two-level taxonomy labels (6 major categories, 18 sub-categories) to support fine-grained analysis of skill retrieval tasks.
summary_en.experiments: 1. Existing general retrieval models have limited performance on skill retrieval tasks, indicating that skill retrieval is a specialized task independent of general text retrieval and tool retrieval. 2. Task-specific fine-tuning on the SkillRet training set brings significant performance gains, and small fine-tuned models can match or even outperform much larger general retrieval models. 3. The benefit of reranking depends on the performance headroom of the first-stage retriever; when the base retriever is strong enough, the marginal benefit of reranking drops rapidly. 4. The performance improvement of fine-tuned models mainly comes from accurate focusing on a small number of skill-relevant key sentences in long queries.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the benchmark construction pipeline and core experimental conclusions for skimming, with an estimated reading time of 15 minutes. For building related retrieval systems, refer to the dataset field descriptions and baseline implementation details in the appendix.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据构造和 disjoint skill pool 设定即可；它不改预训练方法，但会影响工具/技能接口如何进后训练数据。
recommendation.en: Read the dataset construction and disjoint skill-pool setup; it does not change pretraining, but it informs how tool and skill interfaces should enter post-training data.

paper.title: Beyond Semantic Similarity: Rethinking Retrieval for Agentic Search via Direct Corpus Interaction
paper.abstract: Modern retrieval systems, whether lexical or semantic, expose a corpus through a fixed similarity interface that compresses access into a single top-k retrieval step before reasoning. This abstraction is efficient, but for agentic search, it becomes a bottleneck: exact lexical constraints, sparse clue conjunctions, local context checks, and multi-step hypothesis refinement are difficult to implement by calling a conventional off-the-shelf retriever, and evidence filtered out early cannot be reco

summary.core_problem: 论文讨论的是 agentic search 里的 retrieval interface 设计，而不是传统意义上的检索模型优化：固定 top-k 语义检索接口会过早压缩证据空间，限制 agent 做精确匹配、局部验证和多步假设修正。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接影响有限，但对“模型能力如何与外部信息接口匹配”有启发。它提醒人注意：当模型推理和工具使用能力变强后，瓶颈可能不在 reasoning，而在检索接口分辨率过低。这个观察对 RAG、tool use、agent training 有价值，不过更偏系统与 agent 设计，不属于基座预训练核心论文。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 DCI（Direct Corpus Interaction），让 agent 不通过 embedding retriever 或向量索引访问语料，而是直接用终端工具与原始语料交互，例如 grep、find、head、sed、简单脚本和文件读取。核心思想是把“检索”从一次 top-k 候选召回，改成一组可组合、可迭代、可局部验证的低层操作。这样 agent 可以自己执行精确词约束、弱线索拼接、局部上下文检查和逐步修正搜索计划。论文还提出 retrieval interface resolution 这个概念，用来描述接口能否在比文档/段落更细的粒度上操作证据。
summary.experiments: 主实验覆盖 BrowseComp-Plus、多跳 QA 和 IR ranking。最显眼的结果是，在相同 Claude Sonnet 4.6 backbone 下，把 Qwen3-Embedding-8B 检索工具替换成 DCI，BrowseComp-Plus 准确率从 69.0% 提到 80.0%，同时成本从 1440 美元降到 1016 美元。多跳 QA 上，结合 Claude Code 的 DCI 平均准确率达到 83.0%，比文中最强 retrieval-agent baseline 高 30.7 个点。IR ranking 上，平均 NDCG@10 达到 68.5%，比最佳检索基线高 21.5 个点。作者还做了轨迹分析，指出收益不主要来自召回更多 gold 文档，而是来自更细粒度的局部搜索和证据验证。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看引言、方法概念图和 BrowseComp-Plus 主结果表，再看 trajectory analysis。重点不是具体 bash 工具，而是作者对 retrieval bottleneck 的重新定义：问题出在接口把证据压缩得太早。若只想判断是否值得跟进，30 到 40 分钟足够。若关心 agent tool-use 训练，可再看 ablation，尤其是受限工具集、上下文管理和语料规模实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that the main bottleneck in agentic search is often not the reasoning model itself but the retrieval interface: a fixed top-k lexical or semantic retriever compresses corpus access too early and makes exact matching, local verification, and iterative hypothesis refinement unnecessarily hard.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is indirect. The main value is conceptual: once models become capable enough to search strategically, the interface to external knowledge can become the limiting factor. That is useful for thinking about RAG, tool use, and agent training, but it is not a core foundation-model pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is DCI, or Direct Corpus Interaction. Instead of querying a dense retriever or vector index, the agent interacts with the raw corpus through general terminal tools such as grep, find, file reads, head, sed, and lightweight scripts. The key idea is to replace one-shot top-k retrieval with a composable set of low-level operations that the agent can chain together. This allows exact lexical constraints, conjunction of weak clues, local context inspection, and iterative search-plan revision. The paper also introduces the notion of retrieval interface resolution, meaning how finely the interface lets the agent operate on evidence beyond document- or passage-level retrieval.
summary_en.experiments: The main evaluations cover BrowseComp-Plus, multi-hop QA, and IR ranking. On BrowseComp-Plus, replacing Qwen3-Embedding-8B retrieval with DCI under the same Claude Sonnet 4.6 backbone improves accuracy from 69.0% to 80.0% while reducing cost from $1,440 to $1,016. On multi-hop QA, DCI combined with Claude Code reaches 83.0 average accuracy, outperforming the strongest retrieval-agent baseline in the paper by 30.7 points. On IR ranking, it achieves 68.5 average NDCG@10, beating the best retrieval baseline by 21.5 points. The trajectory analyses are especially informative: the gains do not mainly come from surfacing more gold documents, but from turning surfaced evidence into finer-grained local search and verification steps.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, read the introduction, the method overview, and the main BrowseComp-Plus result table first. Then look at the trajectory analysis. The important idea is not the specific shell tools but the reframing of retrieval failure: evidence is often lost because the interface is too coarse. If the goal is just to assess relevance, 30 to 40 minutes is enough. If you care about agent tool-use training, the ablations on restricted tool profiles, context management, and corpus scale are the next sections to read.

recommendation.zh: 仅看方法部分对检索范式的设计即可，可作为内部Agent检索模块ablation参考，无预训练直接相关创新
recommendation.en: Only read the method section for retrieval paradigm design, can be used as reference for internal Agent retrieval module ablation, no direct pretrain-related innovation

paper.title: Retrieval from Within: An Intrinsic Capability of Attention-Based Models
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically treats retrieval and generation as separate systems. We ask whether an attention-based encoder-decoder can instead retrieve directly from its own internal representations. We introduce INTRA (INTrinsic Retrieval via Attention), a framework where decoder attention queries score pre-encoded evidence chunks that are then directly reused as context for generation. By construction, INTRA unifies retrieval and generation, eliminating the retriever-generat

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的是 RAG 中检索器和生成器分离带来的表示错配与重复编码成本：外部 retriever 用一套表示选择证据，generator 再把选中的文本重新消费。作者问的是，encoder-decoder 模型能否直接用自身 attention 表示完成证据检索，并把同一份 encoded evidence 用于生成。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，但对架构和统一检索-生成接口有启发。它强调 attention 的 query-conditioned matching 可以作为检索接口，而不一定要把 retrieval 做成外部系统。这个方向对长上下文、记忆增强模型、encoder-decoder 预训练目标有参考价值：如果 evidence chunk 的 encoder states 可以被预计算并跨 query 复用，那么检索与生成之间的表示边界会变薄，系统也可能减少“检索分数高但生成器不用”的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 INTRA，核心是用同一个 pretrained encoder-decoder 的表示空间同时做 evidence selection 和 answer generation。每个 corpus chunk 先由 encoder 编成 token-level states，并作为可复用的 evidence memory。检索阶段不引入独立 retriever，而是在 decoder 输入中加入 R 个可训练 retrieval tokens，使 decoder cross-attention 产生 query-side retrieval states。然后用类似 ColBERT 的 late interaction，把 decoder query states 与每个 chunk 的 encoder token states 做 token-level matching，再聚合成 chunk-level retrieval score。被选中的 encoded chunks 不需要还原成文本再重新编码，而是直接作为 decoder cross-attention memory 参与生成。这个设计的关键取舍是：它不是要替代大规模语料库上的工业检索系统，而是在固定知识库和多跳 QA 这类设置中减少 retriever-generator mismatch，并摊销静态 evidence 的编码开销。
summary.experiments: 论文在问答任务上评估 evidence recall 和 end-to-end answer quality，重点强调多跳 QA 场景。根据正文描述，INTRA 在证据召回和最终回答质量上优于强工程化 retrieval pipelines，并且这些 pipelines 通常依赖大规模训练数据或独立检索模块。实验还分析了 reusable-context regime：静态 evidence 只需编码一次，后续 query 复用 encoder states，因此计算开销从反复长上下文编码转向检索 query 与预编码 memory 的匹配。当前给出的全文片段没有包含完整表格数字，因此不应把性能幅度外推到更大开放语料检索场景。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看 Method 中 encoder chunk states、decoder retrieval tokens、cross-attention query 暴露方式，以及 ColBERT-style late interaction 如何从 token-level attention/matching 得到 chunk score。实验部分优先看多跳 QA 的 evidence recall、answer quality 对比，以及计算分析中“预编码 evidence 跨 query 复用”的成本模型。若关注预训练，可以重点思考这种接口是否需要在预训练阶段加入 retrieval-token 或 memory-selection 目标，而不是只在下游 QA 上适配。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the separation between retrieval and generation in standard RAG. External retrievers select evidence in one representation space, while the generator consumes the selected text in another pass. The question is whether a pretrained encoder-decoder can retrieve from its own encoded evidence states and then reuse those same states for generation.
summary_en.importance: The direct contribution to foundation-model pretraining is limited, but the architectural signal is useful. INTRA treats attention as a query-conditioned retrieval interface rather than only as an internal computation inside generation. This matters for memory-augmented models, long-context alternatives, and encoder-decoder pretraining: if static evidence can be encoded once and reused across queries, the boundary between retrieval and generation becomes less rigid, and the retriever-generator mismatch can be reduced.
summary_en.technical_approach: INTRA uses a single pretrained encoder-decoder representation space for both evidence selection and answer generation. Corpus chunks are encoded into token-level encoder states and stored as reusable memories. At retrieval time, the decoder input is augmented with R trainable retrieval tokens, exposing decoder-side query states through cross-attention. A ColBERT-style late-interaction scoring function compares these query states against the token states of each encoded chunk and aggregates the matches into chunk-level retrieval scores. The selected encoded chunks are then fed directly as decoder cross-attention memory for generation, without converting them back into raw text and re-encoding them. The design is not framed as a full replacement for large-scale industrial retrieval; it is better understood as a unified retrieval-generation interface for fixed evidence collections, especially when evidence can be pre-encoded.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates question answering with evidence recall and end-to-end answer quality, with an emphasis on multi-hop QA. The reported results indicate that INTRA outperforms strong engineered retrieval pipelines on both evidence selection and final answer quality, despite those pipelines using separate retrievers and often larger-scale retrieval training. The paper also studies the computation profile of the reusable-context setting: static evidence is encoded once, and later queries operate over cached encoder states. The provided content does not include the full result tables or exact margins, so the claims should be read as evidence for this setting rather than as a general statement about open-corpus retrieval at web scale.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. The key parts are the method definitions for encoded chunk memories, decoder-side retrieval tokens, exposed cross-attention query states, and the ColBERT-style late-interaction chunk scorer. In the experiments, prioritize the multi-hop QA evidence-recall and answer-quality comparisons, then inspect the compute analysis for the pre-encoded-evidence regime. For pretraining researchers, the main question to carry forward is whether retrieval tokens or memory-selection objectives should be introduced during pretraining instead of being added only during downstream adaptation.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是它把 retrieval 重新写成 attention memory access；若实验对比足够干净，这会影响你对 RAG 与原生记忆边界的判断，但先重点核查 baseline 是否公平。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it recasts retrieval as native attention-based memory access; if the comparisons are clean, it shifts how you think about the boundary between RAG and built-in memory, but audit the baselines first.

paper.title: Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) · 小红书笔记 by Yuz9Yuz
paper.abstract: Yuz9Yuz 关注 告别BM25、ColBERT，拥抱grep 📣 最近组里叙事最宏大的一篇工作上线了，由 @李卓风 领衔，和多所学校的合作者们共同完成，同时也感谢多位大佬的指点 🧠 agentic search 最近很火，那怎么让模型在这个任务上表现更好呢？我们做了一个有些“反常识”的操作。 ❌ 不是换更强的 embedding ❌ 不是换更大的 reranker ✔️ 而是放弃传统意义上的搜索工具 (例如 BM25、ColBERT) ✔️ 直接用命令行工具 (例如 grep、find) 对原始 corpus 动手 当类似 Claude Code 这样的 CLI 智能体已经足够擅长使用命令行工具时，最好的搜索工具，可能就是命令行工具 🔍 随着智能体越来越强，现在很多 agentic search 的失败，其实不是模型不会推理，而是搜索工具在最开始就把关键证据过滤掉了 对于搜索而言，已有的方法无非是：BM25 → dense retrieval → 更复杂的 reranking 但是！ 🤔 为什么要让智能体透过这些 “top-k 相关” 的滤镜去看世界呢？ 于是我们的方法，Direc

summary.core_problem: 文章讨论 agentic search 里一个常见但容易被忽略的问题：失败往往不在模型推理，而在检索前端过早用 BM25、dense retrieval、reranker 把关键证据过滤掉。作者提出让 CLI 智能体直接对原始语料做 grep/find/rg 等命令行交互，绕开传统检索栈。
summary.key_insights: 最有信息量的点有两个。第一，作者把“搜索”重写成“对 corpus 的直接程序化操作”，认为当 Claude Code 这类智能体已经足够会用命令行时，CLI 本身可以成为搜索接口，而不是先做 embedding 和 top-k 召回。第二，给出的实验结论很明确：在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，基于 DCI 的 Claude Sonnet 4.6 达到 80.0% 准确率，且相对传统搜索工具链还有 29.4% 成本下降；即便是更简单的 CLI agent，加上一些上下文管理，也能超过若干已有搜索 agent。这个判断对 agent 工具设计有启发：检索器未必越复杂越好，保真度有时比压缩后的相关性排序更重要。
summary.limits: 信息来源是小红书笔记，技术细节、实验设置和统计显著性都不完整，暂时更适合当作方向性信号而不是定论。作者也明确承认方法对小而动态的 corpus 更合适，规模到 20 万文档后工具调用次数和准确率都明显恶化；因此它更像是对现有 retrieval 假设的挑战，而不是已经解决大规模搜索的通用方案。

summary_en.core_problem: This note argues that many agentic search failures come from the retrieval layer, not the reasoning model: BM25, dense retrieval, and rerankers may discard the crucial evidence before the agent ever sees it. The proposed alternative is Direct Corpus Interaction, where a CLI agent searches the raw corpus directly with grep/find/rg-style tools.
summary_en.key_insights: The memorable idea is to treat search as direct manipulation of the corpus rather than retrieval over an indexed abstraction. If models like Claude Code are already competent at command-line tool use, a shell can become the search interface. The note also provides concrete claims: Claude Sonnet 4.6 with DCI reportedly reaches 80.0% on BrowseComp-Plus while reducing cost by 29.4% versus a traditional search stack, and even simpler CLI agents can outperform several competitive search agents. For agent design, the implication is that preserving evidence may matter more than increasingly sophisticated top-k retrieval pipelines.
summary_en.limits: This is a short social-media summary, so the methodological detail is thin and the claims cannot be audited fully from the note alone. The author also states a clear boundary: DCI works better on smaller, frequently changing corpora, but degrades as corpus size grows, with more tool calls and lower accuracy around the 200k-document scale. So this is best read as a useful challenge to standard retrieval assumptions, not yet a general replacement for large-scale search.

paper.title: Storage Is Not Memory: A Retrieval-Centered Architecture for Agent Recall
paper.abstract: Extraction at ingestion is the wrong primitive for agent memory: content discarded before the query is known cannot be recovered at retrieval time. We propose True Memory, a six-layer architecture that shifts the center of the system from a storage schema to a multi-stage retrieval pipeline operating over events preserved verbatim. The full system runs as a single SQLite file on commodity CPU with no external database, vector index, graph store, or GPU. On LoCoMo (1,540 questions across 10 multi

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程 Agent 记忆中“入库时先抽取、检索时再回答”会丢失信息的问题，主张把原始事件完整保留，把系统重心放到检索流水线而不是存储 schema。
summary.importance: 这是 Agent memory 架构工作，不是基座预训练论文，但对“记忆应在写入时压缩还是在读取时推理”这个设计点给了较干净的工程论证。贡献类型主要是系统设计、评测和消融，而不是新的学习范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 True Memory 六层架构：保留 verbatim events，不依赖向量库、图数据库或外部检索系统，而是在单个 SQLite 文件上做多阶段检索与重排。核心主张是 ingestion 阶段不要过早抽取和压缩，避免 query 未知时的信息不可逆丢失；真正的“记忆”发生在 retrieval pipeline 中，而不是预定义存储结构中。
summary.experiments: 在 LoCoMo 上，True Memory Pro 在匹配的 gpt-4.1-mini answer model 下达到 93.0% 准确率，高于 Mem0 的 61.4%、Supermemory 的 65.4%、约 71% 的 Zep，接近 EverMemOS 的 94.5%。在 LongMemEval 上达到 87.8%，在 100 万 token 规模的 BEAM-1M 上达到 76.6%，高于已发表的 Hindsight 73.9%。还做了 56 组消融，说明性能并非来自单一 heuristic。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Sauron Labs。论文更像一篇面向 Agent memory 系统设计的强工程论文，关注点是检索架构与评测，而不是 LLM 预训练本身。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the failure mode of agent memory systems that extract and compress information at ingestion time, arguing that information discarded before the query is known cannot be recovered later.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory systems paper rather than a foundation-model pretraining paper, but it gives a fairly clean argument about a real design choice: whether memory should be compressed on write or reasoned over on read. The contribution is mainly architectural, evaluative, and empirical.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes True Memory, a six-layer retrieval-centered architecture that stores events verbatim and shifts the intelligence into a multi-stage retrieval pipeline. It runs in a single SQLite file on CPU, without an external vector DB, graph store, or GPU. The key idea is to avoid irreversible extraction at ingestion and defer structure induction to retrieval time.
summary_en.experiments: On LoCoMo, True Memory Pro reaches 93.0% accuracy with a matched gpt-4.1-mini answer model, outperforming Mem0 (61.4%), Supermemory (65.4%), and Zep (~71%), and approaching EverMemOS (94.5%). It also reports 87.8% on LongMemEval and 76.6% on BEAM-1M, above the prior published Hindsight result of 73.9%. A 56-setting ablation suggests the gains are not from a single heuristic.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Sauron Labs. The work is best read as a strong agent-memory systems paper focused on retrieval architecture and evaluation, not as a pretraining contribution.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深，但它把“写时抽取”这条常见 memory prior 打得很具体；只看架构图和 ablation，别把 benchmark 胜负直接外推到通用 Agent。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly attacks the common write-time extraction prior in agent memory; read the architecture and ablations, not the leaderboard as a universal agent claim.

paper.title: MEMTIER: Tiered Memory Architecture and Retrieval Bottleneck Analysis for Long-Running Autonomous AI Agents
paper.abstract: Long-running autonomous AI agents suffer from a well-documented memory coherence problem: tool-execution success rates degrade 14 percentage points over 72-hour operation windows due to four compounding failure modes in existing flat-file memory systems. We present MEMTIER, a tripartite memory architecture for the OpenClaw agent runtime that introduces a structured episodic JSONL store, a five-signal weighted retrieval engine, an attention-attributed cognitive weight update loop, an asynchronous

summary.core_problem: 长时运行的自主AI Agent现有扁平内存架构存在上下文截断、压缩断层、结构感知缺失、无归因回路四个失效模式，72小时运行后工具调用成功率下降14个百分点，无法支持多日连续会话的知识积累和优先级调度。
summary.importance: 验证了Agent记忆系统的性能瓶颈主要在检索架构而非基座模型，为面向Agent的基座预训练中内置记忆分层机制、接入检索归因信号提供了实证依据；提出的认知权重更新逻辑可复用在持续预训练的样本优先级评分中。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MemTier三层内存架构，包含带来源链、认知权重跟踪的结构化JSONL episodic存储，融合BM25、时间衰减、认知权重、层级加权的五信号加权检索引擎，注意力归因的认知权重更新回路，将高频有用episodic事实提取到语义层的异步 consolidation 守护进程，以及PPO自适应检索权重框架，同时支持多Agent内存隔离和跨Agent知识共享。
summary.experiments: 在500题LongMemEval-S基准上，用7B模型在6GB消费级GPU上准确率达0.382、F1=0.412，比全上下文基线提升33个百分点，单会话召回超过GPT-4o RAG BM25基线；实验发现BM25检索架构是当前性能天花板，基座模型和检索权重对性能影响很小；语义层事实抽取可将内存规模压缩164倍，F1提升51倍，同时降低单查询token成本。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3节架构设计、3.3节的瓶颈分析实验，预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing flat memory architectures for long-running autonomous AI agents have four failure modes: context truncation, compaction discontinuity, structural blindness, and no attribution loop, leading to a 14 percentage point drop in tool execution success rate after 72 hours of operation, and cannot support knowledge accumulation and priority scheduling across multi-day continuous sessions.
summary_en.importance: It verifies that the performance bottleneck of agent memory systems lies in the retrieval architecture rather than the base model, providing empirical evidence for integrating built-in memory hierarchical mechanisms and retrieval attribution signals into agent-oriented base model pre-training. The proposed cognitive weight update logic can also be reused for sample priority scoring in continuous pre-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes MemTier, a tripartite memory architecture. It includes structured JSONL episodic storage with provenance chains and cognitive weight tracking, a five-signal weighted retrieval engine combining BM25, time decay, cognitive weight and tier boost, an attention-attributed cognitive weight update loop, an asynchronous consolidation daemon that distills high-value episodic facts to the semantic tier, and a PPO-based adaptive retrieval weight framework. It also supports multi-agent memory isolation and cross-agent knowledge sharing.
summary_en.experiments: On the 500-question LongMemEval-S benchmark, it achieves 0.382 accuracy and 0.412 F1 with a 7B model on a 6GB consumer GPU, 33 percentage points higher than the full-context baseline, and single-session recall exceeds the GPT-4o RAG BM25 baseline. Experiments show that BM25 retrieval architecture is the current performance ceiling, with minimal impact from base model selection and retrieval weights. Semantic tier fact extraction compresses memory size by 164x, improves F1 by 51x, and reduces per-query token cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for architecture design and Section 3.3 for bottleneck analysis experiments. Estimated reading time: 12 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 可读检索失败分类和 LongMemEval-S setup；full-context 5% baseline 偏低，别把增益当成通用结论。
recommendation.en: Skim the retrieval failure taxonomy and LongMemEval-S setup; the 5% full-context baseline is suspiciously weak, so treat the gain as a systems signal, not a general law.
